    18/**
    19 * @file usher.c
    20 * @brief Main USHER daemon coordinating flight-controller triggers and camera backends.
    21 * @details The event loop receives validated UART frames, queues bounded capture jobs,
    22 * dispatches backend work on detached workers, records metadata, and returns status.
    23 * It deliberately keeps serial I/O separate from slow camera processes so one capture
    24 * cannot block command reception. Backend failure is isolated per camera wherever
    25 * possible; systemd owns whole-daemon restart for irrecoverable transport failures.
    26 *
    27 * @par Ownership at a glance
    28 * The event loop owns protocol dispatch and survey admission. Optical tickets
    29 * serialize CHDK/AIcam access; live LWIR has a separate worker and recovery lock.
    30 * A split-phase image retains its backend completion table after the optical lane
    31 * is released. Live SODA uses a separate single worker and owns filenames only.
    32 * Keep these boundaries distinct: accepting a trigger, owning pixels and saving a
    33 * geotagged original are three different events.
    34 * @warning Bounded workers prevent software backlog growth; they do not isolate
    35 * shared power, storage, kernel stalls or the whole board's memory consumption.
    36 */

    130struct option_alias {
    131 const char *name;
    132 char option[3];
    133 bool requires_argument;
    134};
    135
    136/** @brief Translate supported long options into the short-option parser's input.
    137 * @param argc Original argument count.
    138 * @param argv Original argument vector.
    139 * @param[out] normalized Output vector borrowing strings from @p argv and @p aliases.
    140 * @param capacity Number of pointer slots including room for the terminator.
    141 * @param aliases Accepted long names, short spellings and operand rules.
    142 * @param alias_count Number of entries in @p aliases.
    143 * @return Normalized count, or -1 on invalid input or insufficient capacity.
    144 * @details Split inline operands without copying their text and preserve
    145 * arguments after the option terminator. Keep both input tables alive. */
    146static int normalize_long_options(int argc, char *const argv[], char *normalized[],
    147 size_t capacity, const struct option_alias aliases[],
    148 size_t alias_count)
    149{
    150 if (argc < 1 || argc > USHER_MAX_ARGUMENTS || capacity == 0) {
    151 return -1;
    152 }
    153 size_t output_count = 0;
    154 normalized[output_count++] = argv[0];
    155 for (int index = 1; index < argc; ++index) {
    156 const char *argument = argv[index];
    157 if (strcmp(argument, "--") == 0) {
    158 if (output_count >= capacity) {
    159 return -1;
    160 }
    161 normalized[output_count++] = argv[index];
    162 for (++index; index < argc; ++index) {
    163 if (output_count >= capacity) {
    164 return -1;
    165 }
    166 normalized[output_count++] = argv[index];
    167 }
    168 break;
    169 }
    170 if (strncmp(argument, "--", 2) != 0 || argument[2] == '\0') {
    171 if (output_count >= capacity) {
    172 return -1;
    173 }
    174 normalized[output_count++] = argv[index];
    175 continue;
    176 }
    177 const char *name = argument + 2;
    178 size_t name_length = strcspn(name, "=");
    179 const char *inline_value = name[name_length] == '=' ? name + name_length + 1 : NULL;
    180 const struct option_alias *alias = NULL;
    181 for (size_t alias_index = 0; alias_index < alias_count; ++alias_index) {
    182 if (strlen(aliases[alias_index].name) == name_length
    183 && strncmp(name, aliases[alias_index].name, name_length) == 0) {
    184 alias = &aliases[alias_index];
    185 break;
    186 }
    187 }
    188 if (alias == NULL || (!alias->requires_argument && inline_value != NULL)
    189 || output_count >= capacity) {
    190 return -1;
    191 }
    192 normalized[output_count++] = (char *)alias->option;
    193 if (alias->requires_argument) {
    194 if (inline_value == NULL) {
    195 if (++index >= argc) {
    196 return -1;
    197 }
    198 inline_value = argv[index];
    199 }
    200 if (output_count >= capacity) {
    201 return -1;
    202 }
    203 normalized[output_count++] = (char *)inline_value;
    204 }
    205 }
    206 if (output_count >= capacity) {
    207 return -1;
    208 }
    209 normalized[output_count] = NULL;
    210 return (int)output_count;
    211}

    249/** @brief Pool-owned worker request; ownership transfers only after thread creation succeeds. */
    250struct capture_job {
    251 union dc_shot_union shot;
    252 uint32_t request_id;
    253 uint8_t camera_mask;
    254 uint64_t ticket; /**< Optical ordering token, not a physical exposure sequence. */
    255 uint64_t received_us; /**< Local receipt time for queue age, never an exposure timestamp. */
    256 bool arbiter_owned; /**< Protect admitted survey ownership from legacy newest-waiting replacement. */
    257 bool shot_counted;
    258};

    402/** @brief Prompt the event loop to recheck shared state.
    403 * @details The nonblocking self-pipe is a hint, not a counted event queue:
    404 * if it is full, an unread byte already makes it readable. Preserve errno
    405 * because a signal may interrupt code that is about to inspect it. */
    406static void wake_event_loop(void)
    407{
    408 const int error = errno;
    409 const uint8_t notification = 1;
    410 if (event_wake_writer >= 0) {
    411 ssize_t written;
    412 do { written = write(event_wake_writer, &notification, sizeof(notification)); } while (written < 0 && errno == EINTR);
    413 }
    414 errno = error;
    415}
    416
    417/** @brief Set up the self-pipe before installing its producers.
    418 * @return Zero on success, or -1 with errno on failure.
    419 * @details Set both ends nonblocking and close-on-exec before publishing
    420 * either descriptor so workers cannot see a partly configured pipe. */
    421static int event_wake_init(void)
    422{
    423 if (event_wake_reader >= 0 || event_wake_writer >= 0) { errno = EBUSY; return -1; }
    424 int descriptors[2];
    425 if (pipe(descriptors) != 0) return -1;
    426 for (size_t index = 0; index < 2; ++index) {
    427 const int flags = fcntl(descriptors[index], F_GETFL);
    428 if (flags < 0 || fcntl(descriptors[index], F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK) < 0
    429 || fcntl(descriptors[index], F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC) < 0) {
    430 const int error = errno;
    431 close(descriptors[0]);
    432 close(descriptors[1]);
    433 errno = error;
    434 return -1;
    435 }
    436 }
    437 event_wake_reader = descriptors[0];
    438 event_wake_writer = descriptors[1];
    439 return 0;
    440}
    441
    442/** @brief Consume pending wake hints without monopolizing the event loop.
    443 * @details Cap the drain work; if writers refill the pipe, the remaining
    444 * bytes will make the next poll readable. */
    445static void drain_event_wake(void)
    446{
    447 uint8_t notifications[64];
    448 for (unsigned attempt = 0; attempt < 4; ++attempt)
    449 if (read(event_wake_reader, notifications, sizeof(notifications)) <= 0) break;
    450}
    451
    452/** @brief Withdraw the wake descriptors and close the self-pipe.
    453 * @details Invalidate the published writer first so later notifications
    454 * can skip the write. Call after ordinary worker producers are quiescent. */
    455static void event_wake_close(void)
    456{
    457 const int writer = event_wake_writer;
    458 event_wake_writer = -1;
    459 if (writer >= 0) close(writer);
    460 if (event_wake_reader >= 0) close(event_wake_reader);
    461 event_wake_reader = -1;
    462}
    463
    464/** @brief Hand one camera's terminal shot result to the serial owner.
    465 * @param request_id Correlation ID; zero denotes a legacy request without an acknowledgement.
    466 * @param number Flight-controller photo number.
    467 * @param camera_id Camera that owns the outcome.
    468 * @param status Wire result code.
    469 * @details Do not block a capture worker on UART backpressure. Count drops
    470 * if the bounded queue fills, and wake the loop even for legacy work. */
    471static void queue_shot_result(uint32_t request_id, int32_t number, unsigned camera_id, uint32_t status)
    472{
    473 if (!request_id) { wake_event_loop(); return; }
    474 pthread_mutex_lock(&shot_result_mutex);
    475 if (shot_result_count == SHOT_RESULT_CAPACITY) ++shot_result_dropped;
    476 else {
    477 union usher_shot_result_union *result = &shot_results[(shot_result_head + shot_result_count++) % SHOT_RESULT_CAPACITY];
    478 *result = (union usher_shot_result_union) {.data = {request_id, number, camera_id, status}};
    479 }
    480 pthread_mutex_unlock(&shot_result_mutex);
    481 wake_event_loop();
    482}

    484/** @brief Report a shared outcome separately for each addressed image camera.
    485 * @param request_id Correlation ID, or zero for a legacy request.
    486 * @param number Flight-controller photo number.
    487 * @param camera_mask Bitmask indexed by camera ID minus one.
    488 * @param status Outcome to report for each selected camera.
    489 * @details Expand only image-camera bits so a shared admission failure
    490 * retains per-camera correlation without generating terminal results for
    491 * non-image backends. */
    492static void queue_image_results(uint32_t request_id, int32_t number, uint8_t camera_mask, uint32_t status)
    493{
    494 for (unsigned camera_id = USHER_CAMERA_CHDK; camera_id <= USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM; ++camera_id)
    495 if (camera_mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1))) queue_shot_result(request_id, number, camera_id, status);
    496}
    497
    498/** @brief Transfer a bounded batch of shot results to the UART transmit queue.
    499 * @details The event loop is the only consumer. Leave the head queued until
    500 * transmit admission succeeds, and release the result lock around that call
    501 * so a worker can append without waiting on the UART path. */
    502static void flush_shot_results(void)
    503{
    504 for (unsigned sent = 0; sent < 16; ++sent) {
    505 pthread_mutex_lock(&shot_result_mutex);
    506 if (!shot_result_count) {
    507 pthread_mutex_unlock(&shot_result_mutex);
    508 return;
    509 }
    510 const union usher_shot_result_union result = shot_results[shot_result_head];
    511 pthread_mutex_unlock(&shot_result_mutex);
    512 if (serial_tx_send(USHER_SHOT_RESULT, result.bin, sizeof(result.bin)) != 0) return;
    513 pthread_mutex_lock(&shot_result_mutex);
    514 shot_result_head = (shot_result_head + 1) % SHOT_RESULT_CAPACITY;
    515 --shot_result_count;
    516 pthread_mutex_unlock(&shot_result_mutex);
    517 }
    518}

    601/** @brief Read USHER's monotonic clock for local latency and event ordering.
    602 * @return Microseconds since an arbitrary monotonic origin, or zero on clock failure. */
    603static uint64_t monotonic_time_us(void)
    604{
    605 struct timespec now;
    606 return clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now) == 0
    607 ? (uint64_t)now.tv_sec * 1000000U + (uint64_t)now.tv_nsec / 1000U : 0;
    608}
    609
    610/** @brief Select the next event-loop polling budget.
    611 * @return Active or idle timeout, in milliseconds.
    612 * @details Keep the shorter timeout while work may need servicing even
    613 * without another UART input. Read capture/control state and shot results
    614 * under their respective locks instead of nesting them. */
    615static int event_loop_timeout_ms(void)
    616{
    617 if (backend_service_pending || capture_arbiter_pending()) return EVENT_LOOP_ACTIVE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    618 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    619 bool pending = shooting_thread_count > 0 || chdk_capture_in_progress || chdk_finish_in_progress
    620 || lwir_capture_in_progress || lwir_handoff_in_progress || lwir_recovery_in_progress;
    621 for (size_t index = 0; index < CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++index)
    622 if (point_sessions[index].id || point_sessions[index].pending || point_update_pending[index]) pending = true;
    623 for (size_t index = 0; index < 8; ++index)
    624 if (control_results[index].dirty) pending = true;
    625 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    626 pthread_mutex_lock(&shot_result_mutex);
    627 pending = pending || shot_result_count != 0;
    628 pthread_mutex_unlock(&shot_result_mutex);
    629 return pending ? EVENT_LOOP_ACTIVE_TIMEOUT_MS : EVENT_LOOP_TIMEOUT_MS;
    630}

    632/** @brief Pause for an interval using nanosleep's remaining-time result.
    633 * @param microseconds Requested interval in microseconds.
    634 * @details On signal interruption, resume only the unfinished portion. */
    635static void sleep_microseconds(uint64_t microseconds)
    636{
    637 struct timespec delay = {
    638 .tv_sec = (time_t)(microseconds / 1000000U),
    639 .tv_nsec = (long)(microseconds % 1000000U) * 1000L
    640 };
    641 while (nanosleep(&delay, &delay) != 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
    642}
    643
    644/** @brief Install a camera's calibrated exposure-to-delivery delay bounds.
    645 * @param camera_id Supported image camera identifier.
    646 * @param value Comma-separated minimum and maximum delays in milliseconds.
    647 * @return True if both bounds were accepted; false leaves the setting unchanged.
    648 * @details Round outward when converting to integer microseconds so unit
    649 * conversion never narrows the supplied uncertainty interval. */
    650static bool set_exposure_latency(unsigned camera_id, const char *value)
    651{
    652 double minimum_ms, maximum_ms;
    653 char extra;
    654 if (camera_id < USHER_CAMERA_CHDK || camera_id > USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM || !value
    655 || sscanf(value, "%lf,%lf%c", &minimum_ms, &maximum_ms, &extra) != 2
    656 || !isfinite(minimum_ms) || !isfinite(maximum_ms)
    657 || minimum_ms < 0 || maximum_ms < minimum_ms || maximum_ms > 2000) return false;
    658 exposure_latency[camera_id].minimum_us = (uint64_t)floor(minimum_ms * 1000);
    659 exposure_latency[camera_id].maximum_us = (uint64_t)ceil(maximum_ms * 1000);
    660 exposure_latency[camera_id].valid = true;
    661 return true;
    662}
    663
    664/** @brief Opportunistically send a low-priority flight-controller clock probe.
    665 * @details Probes are rate-limited to one per second and sent only on an idle UART so
    666 * alignment evidence cannot delay capture/status traffic. */
    667static void send_clock_probe(uint64_t now_us)
    668{
    669 if (!clock_probes_enabled || now_us == 0 || now_us < next_clock_probe_us
    670 || now_us > UINT64_MAX - 1000000) return;
    671 next_clock_probe_us = now_us + 1000000;
    672 union usher_clock_request_union token = {.data = {
    673 .token_low = (uint32_t)now_us,
    674 .token_high = (uint32_t)(now_us >> 32) ^ (uint32_t)getpid() ^ (uint32_t)(clock_probe_count + 1)
    675 }
    676 };
    677 const uint64_t sent_us = monotonic_time_us();
    678 if (!clock_alignment_request(&fc_clock, token, sent_us)) return;
    679 if (serial_tx_send_if_idle(USHER_CLOCK_REQUEST, token.bin, sizeof(token.bin)) != 0) {
    680 fc_clock.pending = false;
    681 return;
    682 }
    683 ++clock_probe_count;
    684}
    685
    686/** @brief Feed one acoustic sample from the pose stream while a listening session is open.
    687 * @details Sampling follows the ordinary pose stream, so a specialized camera needs no
    688 * capture commands of its own. Without that stream the session collects nothing. */
    689static void camera_record_pose(const uint8_t *payload, uint16_t length)
    690{
    691 if (length != USHER_POSE_SAMPLE_MSG_SIZE) return;
    692 union usher_pose_sample_union sample;
    693 for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(sample.bin); ++index) sample.bin[index] = payload[index];
    694 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++camera_id) {
    695 const struct camera_backend *owner = &camera_owners[camera_id];
    696 if (owner->session && owner->session->listening && owner->session->listening() && owner->record)
    697 owner->record(&sample.data.shot);
    698 }
    699}
    700
    701/** @brief Validate and enqueue a token-bound pose sample with clock evidence.
    702 * @details Mapping failure does not discard the pose: the log records it as unmapped,
    703 * preserving raw diagnostic evidence without claiming false time precision. */
    704static void record_clocked_pose(void)
    705{
    706 if (usher_protocol.payload_len != USHER_POSE_CLOCKED_MSG_SIZE) {
    707 pose_log_record(NULL, 0, serial_receive_monotonic_us);
    708 return;
    709 }
    710 union usher_pose_clocked_union message;
    711 for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(message.bin); ++index) message.bin[index] = usher_protocol.payload[index];
    712 struct pose_clock_evidence evidence = {.token = message.data.request};
    713 struct clock_interval begin, end;
    714 if (clock_alignment_map(&fc_clock, message.data.request, message.data.sample.data.sample_begin_us,
    715 serial_receive_monotonic_us, &begin)
    716 && clock_alignment_map(&fc_clock, message.data.request, message.data.sample.data.sample_end_us,
    717 serial_receive_monotonic_us, &end)) {
    718 evidence.sample_time = (struct clock_interval) {begin.earliest_us, end.latest_us};
    719 evidence.probe_sent_us = fc_clock.mapped_sent_us;
    720 evidence.probe_received_us = fc_clock.received_us;
    721 evidence.probe_receive_fc_us = fc_clock.receive_fc_us;
    722 evidence.probe_transmit_fc_us = fc_clock.anchor_fc_us;
    723 evidence.mapped = true;
    724 capture_arbiter_pose_sample(&message.data.sample, begin.earliest_us, end.latest_us);
    725 } else {
    726 capture_arbiter_pose_invalidate();
    727 }
    728 pose_log_record_clocked(message.data.sample.bin, sizeof(message.data.sample.bin),
    729 serial_receive_monotonic_us, &evidence);
    730 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++camera_id)
    731 if (camera_owners[camera_id].pose_updated) camera_owners[camera_id].pose_updated();
    732 camera_record_pose(message.data.sample.bin, sizeof(message.data.sample.bin));
    733}

    1482
    1483 // Drain available serial data in one syscall and process frames in order.
    1484 ssize_t bytes_read = 0;
    1485 if ((event_sources[0].revents & POLLIN) != 0) {
    1486 bytes_read = read(fd, serial_buffer, sizeof(serial_buffer));
    1487 serial_receive_monotonic_us = monotonic_time_us();
    1488 }
    1489 if (bytes_read > 0) {
    1490 for (ssize_t index = 0; index < bytes_read; index++) {
    1491 serial_byte_count++;
    1492 uint8_t parser_errors_before = usher_protocol.error;
    1493 if (debug_enabled && serial_buffer[index] == STX) {
    1494 printf("USHER DEBUG:\treceived USHER frame start at serial byte %llu\n",
    1495 (unsigned long long)serial_byte_count);
    1496 }
    1497 parse_usher(&usher_protocol, serial_buffer[index]);
    1498 if (usher_protocol.error != parser_errors_before) {
    1499 rejected_frame_count++;
    1500 if (debug_enabled) {
    1501 printf("USHER DEBUG:\trejected USHER frame at serial byte %llu (total rejected: %llu)\n",
    1502 (unsigned long long)serial_byte_count,
    1503 (unsigned long long)rejected_frame_count);
    1504 }
    1505 }
    1506 if (usher_protocol.msg_received) {
    1507 valid_frame_count++;
    1508 if (debug_enabled) {
    1509 printf("USHER DEBUG:\taccepted USHER message id %u with %u payload bytes "
    1510 "(frame %llu)\n",
    1511 usher_protocol.msg_id, usher_protocol.payload_len,
    1512 (unsigned long long)valid_frame_count);
    1513 }
    1514 handle_received_message();
    1515 }
    1516 }
    1517 } else if (bytes_read < 0 && errno != EAGAIN && errno != EWOULDBLOCK && errno != EINTR) {
    1518 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tserial read failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    1519 }
    1520
    1521 if (debug_enabled && time(NULL) >= next_debug_heartbeat) {
    1522 pthread_mutex_lock(&shot_result_mutex);
    1523 printf("USHER SHOT RESULTS:\tpending=%zu dropped=%" PRIu64 "\n", shot_result_count, shot_result_dropped);
    1524 pthread_mutex_unlock(&shot_result_mutex);
    1525 printf("USHER DEBUG:\twaiting for USHER data: %llu bytes, %llu valid frames, "
    1526 "%llu rejected frames\n",
    1527 (unsigned long long)serial_byte_count,
    1528 (unsigned long long)valid_frame_count,
    1529 (unsigned long long)rejected_frame_count);
    1530 struct pose_log_stats pose_status = pose_log_status();
    1531 printf("USHER POSE:\taccepted=%" PRIu64 " synced=%" PRIu64 " dropped=%" PRIu64
    1532 " rejected=%" PRIu64 " error=%d\n", pose_status.accepted, pose_status.synced,
    1533 pose_status.dropped, pose_status.rejected, pose_status.error);
    1534 next_debug_heartbeat = time(NULL) + DEBUG_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS;
    1535 if (clock_probes_enabled) {
    1536 printf("USHER CLOCK:\tprobes=%" PRIu64 " accepted=%" PRIu64 " rejected=%" PRIu64 "\n",
    1537 clock_probe_count, clock_reply_count, clock_rejected_count);
    1538 }
    1539 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    1540 printf("USHER SODA:\tpending=%zu active=%d deferred=%" PRIu64 " completed=%" PRIu64
    1541 " failed=%" PRIu64 " unavailable/full=%" PRIu64 "\n",
    1542 soda_backlog_count, soda_backlog_active, soda_busy_deferred_count,
    1543 soda_backlog_completed, soda_backlog_failed, soda_backlog_overflow);
    1544 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    1545 }
    1546
    1547 // Read the socket
    1548 if ((event_sources[1].revents & POLLIN) != 0
    1549 && socket_recv(image_buffer[image_idx], IMAGE_SIZE) == IMAGE_SIZE) {
    1550 image_idx = (image_idx + 1) % MAX_IMAGE_BUFFERS;
    1551
    1552 if (image_count < MAX_IMAGE_BUFFERS) {
    1553 image_count++;
    1554 }
    1555 }
    1556
    1557 }
    1558
    1559 // Close
    1560 capture_set_running(&keep_running, false);
    1561 capture_arbiter_stop();
    1562 drain_camera_backends();
    1563 stop_soda_backlog();
    1564 stop_pangea();
    1565 socket_deinit();
    1566 serial_tx_stop();
    1567 close(fd);
    1568 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    1569 pthread_cond_broadcast(&camera_available);
    1570 while (shooting_thread_count > 0 || chdk_capture_in_progress || chdk_finish_in_progress
    1571 || lwir_capture_in_progress || lwir_handoff_in_progress || lwir_recovery_in_progress) {
    1572 pthread_cond_wait(&workers_finished, &mut);
    1573 }
    1574 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    1575 pthread_mutex_lock(&shot_result_mutex);
    1576 fprintf(stderr, "USHER SHOT RESULTS:\tundelivered=%zu dropped=%" PRIu64 "\n",
    1577 shot_result_count, shot_result_dropped);
    1578 pthread_mutex_unlock(&shot_result_mutex);
    1579 cameras_deinit();
    1580 stop_local_serial_bridge();
    1581
    1582 if (pose_log_stop() != 0) fprintf(stderr, "USHER POSE:\tlog incomplete: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    1583 struct pose_log_stats pose_status = pose_log_status();
    1584 fprintf(stderr, "USHER POSE:\tfinal accepted=%" PRIu64 " synced=%" PRIu64
    1585 " dropped=%" PRIu64 " rejected=%" PRIu64 " error=%d\n",
    1586 pose_status.accepted, pose_status.synced, pose_status.dropped, pose_status.rejected, pose_status.error);
    1587 event_wake_close();
    1588 printf("USHER:\tShutdown\n");
    1589 return 0;
    1590}
    1591
    1592/** @brief Send READY=1 to systemd when launched with a notify socket.
    1593 * @details Failure is diagnostic only: USHER also supports direct/manual execution. */
    1594static void notify_systemd_ready(void)
    1595{
    1596 const char *socket_path = getenv("NOTIFY_SOCKET");
    1597 if (socket_path == NULL || socket_path[0] == '\0') {
    1598 return;
    1599 }
    1600
    1601 struct sockaddr_un address = {.sun_family = AF_UNIX};
    1602 size_t path_length = strlen(socket_path);
    1603 if (path_length >= sizeof(address.sun_path)) {
    1604 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tsystemd notification socket path is too long\n");
    1605 return;
    1606 }
    1607
    1608 for (size_t index = 0; index <= path_length; index++) {
    1609 address.sun_path[index] = socket_path[index];
    1610 }
    1611 bool abstract_socket = address.sun_path[0] == '@';
    1612 if (abstract_socket) {
    1613 address.sun_path[0] = '\0';
    1614 }
    1615
    1616 int notify_fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    1617 if (notify_fd < 0) {
    1618 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tfailed to create systemd notification socket: %s\n",
    1619 strerror(errno));
    1620 return;
    1621 }
    1622 if (fcntl(notify_fd, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC) != 0) {
    1623 close(notify_fd);
    1624 return;
    1625 }
    1626
    1627 static const char ready_message[] = "READY=1\nSTATUS=MORA serial ready; camera selected on shoot command";
    1628 socklen_t address_length = (socklen_t)(offsetof(struct sockaddr_un, sun_path)
    1629 + path_length + (abstract_socket ? 0 : 1));
    1630 if (sendto(notify_fd, ready_message, sizeof(ready_message) - 1, MSG_NOSIGNAL,
    1631 (const struct sockaddr *)&address, address_length) < 0) {
    1632 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tfailed to notify systemd that startup completed: %s\n",
    1633 strerror(errno));
    1634 }
    1635 close(notify_fd);
    1636}
    1637
    1638/** @brief Consume one optical ticket, then finish images outside the lane where safe.
    1639 * @param ptr Pool-owned capture_job, released on every worker exit.
    1640 * @return NULL, as required by pthread entry points.
    1641 * @details The worker slot and camera lane have different lifetimes: publication
    1642 * may still own a bounded worker slot after the next acquisition has started.
    1643 */
    1644static void *handle_msg_shoot(void *ptr)
    1645{
    1646 struct capture_job *job = ptr;
    1647
    1648 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    1649 while (job->ticket != next_capture_ticket && usher_running()) {
    1650 pthread_cond_wait(&camera_available, &mut);
    1651 }
    1652 if (!usher_running()) {
    1653 if (waiting_capture == job) waiting_capture = NULL;
    1654 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    1655 capture_arbiter_failed(&job->shot, job->camera_mask);
    1656 queue_image_results(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, job->camera_mask, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    1657 release_worker_slot();
    1658 capture_job_release(job);
    1659 return NULL;
    1660 }
    1661
    1662 is_shooting = 1;
    1663 if (!job->shot_counted) shooting_count++;
    1664 if (waiting_capture == job) waiting_capture = NULL;
    1665 if (debug_enabled) {
    1666 uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    1667 printf("USHER-%d DEBUG:\tqueue age %.3f s, superseded live triggers %" PRIu64 "\n",
    1668 job->shot.data.nr, now_us >= job->received_us ? (now_us - job->received_us) / 1e6 : 0,
    1669 superseded_capture_count);
    1670 }
    1671 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    1672
    1673 /* Acquisition holds the camera lane; ordinary optical publication and EXIF can
    1674 * finish after it is released. Live SODA is always submitted elsewhere. LWIR is finished
    1675 * inside the slot because its geolocation reads the backend's last-capture state;
    1676 * --spottercam has the same hazard (spotter_cam_pipe's last-detection state is
    1677 * likewise a single static slot, not part of `image`), so it is finished inside too. */
    1678 const bool separate_lwir = lwir_async_recovery_enabled
    1679 && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only;
    1680 struct captured_image images[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM];
    1681 int image_count_ready = 0;
    1682 const int ordered_camera_max = separate_lwir ? USHER_CAMERA_AICAM : USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM;
    1683 for (int camera_id = USHER_CAMERA_CHDK; camera_id <= ordered_camera_max && usher_running(); ++camera_id) {
    1684 if ((job->camera_mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1))) != 0) {
    1685 if (camera_prepare(camera_id) != 0) {
    1686 capture_arbiter_complete(&job->shot, camera_id, false, false, 0, monotonic_time_us());
    1687 queue_shot_result(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, camera_id, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    1688 continue;
    1689 }
    1690 struct captured_image *image = &images[image_count_ready];
    1691 if (!capture_image(&job->shot, image, camera_id, &camera)) {
    1692 queue_shot_result(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, camera_id, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    1693 continue;
    1694 }
    1695 bool finish_in_slot = (image->backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_FINISH_OWNED) != 0;
    1696 if (finish_in_slot)
    1697 queue_shot_result(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, camera_id,
    1698 finish_image(&job->shot, image) ? USHER_SHOT_SAVED : USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    1699 else ++image_count_ready;
    1700 }
    1701 }
    1702
    1703 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    1704 is_shooting = 0;
    1705 ++next_capture_ticket;
    1706 pthread_cond_broadcast(&camera_available);
    1707 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    1708 for (int index = 0; index < image_count_ready; ++index) {
    1709 queue_shot_result(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, images[index].camera_id,
    1710 finish_image(&job->shot, &images[index]) ? USHER_SHOT_SAVED : USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    1711 }
    1712 release_worker_slot();
    1713 capture_job_release(job);
    1714 return NULL;
    1715}
    1716
    1717/** @brief Acquire pixels or a completed file for a single camera.
    1718 * @param shoot Original pose-tagged request; not automatically exposure-time pose.
    1719 * @param[out] image Per-image state passed to finish_image() on success.
    1720 * @param camera_id Sensor identity used for metadata and independent survey accounting.
    1721 * @param backend Driver selected under the caller's camera ownership.
    1722 * @return True when finish_image() is owed, including pending split-phase captures.
    1723 * @note A negative acquire result must not fall through to a second exposure.
    1724 * Only the driver's explicit positive fallback result allows synchronous shooting.
    1725 */
    1726static bool capture_image(const union dc_shot_union *shoot, struct captured_image *image,
    1727 int camera_id, const struct camera_backend *backend)
    1728{
    1729 if (!shoot || !image || !backend || !(backend->capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_IMAGE)
    1730 || !backend->shoot || !backend->deinit
    1731 || ((backend->capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_DETECTION)
    1732 && (!backend->bind_frame || !backend->detection_summary || !backend->save_detection_copy))
    1733 || ((backend->capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_GEOLOCATION) && !backend->geolocate)
    1734 || camera_id < USHER_CAMERA_CHDK || camera_id > USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM) return false;
    1735 char *filename = image->filename;
    1736 image->backend = *backend;
    1737 if (test_capture_enabled || local_capture_only || mock_map_enabled)
    1738 image->backend.capabilities &= ~CAMERA_CAP_PRIVATE_IMAGE;
    1739 const struct camera_backend identity = camera_identity_get(camera_id);
    1740 image->backend.camera_id = camera_id;
    1741 image->backend.prefix = identity.prefix;
    1742 image->backend.mock = identity.mock;
    1743 image->backend.soda_option = identity.soda_option;
    1744 filename[0] = '\0';
    1745 image->camera_id = camera_id;
    1746 image->exposure_pose_valid = false;
    1747 image->pose_uncertainty_m = 0;
    1748 image->pending = (struct camera_pending) {0};
    1749 image->capture_delay = -1;
    1750 image->capture_times = (struct capture_timing) {0};
    1751 if (!test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only && !mock_map_enabled
    1752 && image->backend.capture_ops && image->backend.capture_ops->acquire && image->backend.capture_ops->finish) {
    1753 const int acquired = image->backend.capture_ops->acquire(&image->pending, shoot->data.nr);
    1754 if (acquired == 0) {
    1755 capture_arbiter_acquired(shoot->data.nr, camera_id, monotonic_time_us());
    1756 return true;
    1757 }
    1758 if (acquired < 0) {
    1759 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, 1U << (camera_id - 1));
    1760 return false;
    1761 }
    1762 }
    1763 printf("USHER-%d:\tShooting: start\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1764 if (debug_enabled) {
    1765 if (test_capture_enabled) {
    1766 printf("USHER-%d DEBUG:\trequesting test image for selected %s backend\n",
    1767 shoot->data.nr, backend->name);
    1768 } else {
    1769 printf("USHER-%d DEBUG:\trequesting image from %s backend\n", shoot->data.nr, backend->name);
    1770 }
    1771 }
    1772 uint64_t capture_started_us = monotonic_time_us();
    1773 int capture_result = mock_map_enabled
    1774 ? local_pipe_map_shoot(filename, sizeof(image->filename), shoot, &image->backend,
    1775 mock_map_cache, mock_map_horizontal_fov, mock_map_vertical_fov)
    1776 : backend->shoot(filename, sizeof(image->filename), shoot->data.nr);
    1777 const uint64_t capture_finished_us = monotonic_time_us();
    1778 if (debug_enabled) {
    1779 printf("USHER-%d TIMING:\tcamera=%d capture_ms=%.3f result=%d\n",
    1780 shoot->data.nr, camera_id, (monotonic_time_us() - capture_started_us) / 1000.0,
    1781 capture_result);
    1782 }
    1783 if (capture_result != 0) {
    1784 capture_arbiter_complete(shoot, camera_id, false, false, 0, monotonic_time_us());
    1785 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\t%s camera capture failed\n", shoot->data.nr, backend->name);
    1786 if (!mock_map_enabled) {
    1787 if (!(camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_CHDK && chdk_async_capture_enabled
    1788 && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only)) camera_close_owner(camera_id);
    1789 if (camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM) lwir_mark_backoff();
    1790 }
    1791 filename[0] = '\0';
    1792 }
    1793 printf("USHER-%d:\tShooting: got image %s\n", shoot->data.nr, filename);
    1794 if (filename[0] != '\0' && mock_transform_enabled) {
    1795 int transform_result = image_mock_transform(filename, shoot);
    1796 if (transform_result < 0) {
    1797 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to apply mock attitude transform to %s\n",
    1798 shoot->data.nr, filename);
    1799 filename[0] = '\0';
    1800 } else if (transform_result == IMAGE_MOCK_TRANSFORM_SKIPPED) {
    1801 printf("USHER-%d:\tShooting: mock attitude transform skipped; source image retained\n",
    1802 shoot->data.nr);
    1803 } else {
    1804 printf("USHER-%d:\tShooting: mock attitude transform applied\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1805 }
    1806 }
    1807 if (filename[0] != '\0' && test_capture_enabled && !mock_map_enabled
    1808 && camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM
    1809 && lwir_cam_pipe_process_mock(filename) != 0) {
    1810 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tLWIR mock processing failed\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1811 filename[0] = '\0';
    1812 }
    1813 if (filename[0] && (test_capture_enabled || local_capture_only || mock_map_enabled)) {
    1814 if (image->backend.name && !strcmp(image->backend.name, "spottercam") &&
    1815 spotter_cam_pipe_analyze(filename, shoot->data.nr))
    1816 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tONNX object analysis failed; retaining photograph\n");
    1817 }
    1818 const bool live_lwir = image->backend.capture_timing && !(image->backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_MOCK);
    1819 image->capture_delay = live_lwir && image->backend.capture_delay ? image->backend.capture_delay() : -1;
    1820 image->capture_times = live_lwir ? image->backend.capture_timing() : (struct capture_timing) {0};
    1821 if (live_lwir && capture_timing_valid(&image->capture_times)) {
    1822 struct capture_observation *observation = &image->capture_times.observation;
    1823 observation->earliest_us = observation->latest_us = image->capture_times.arrival_monotonic_us;
    1824 observation->sequence = image->capture_times.callback_sequence;
    1825 observation->kind = CAPTURE_TIME_FRAME_ARRIVAL;
    1826 if (exposure_latency[camera_id].valid)
    1827 capture_observation_latency(observation, image->capture_times.arrival_monotonic_us,
    1828 exposure_latency[camera_id].minimum_us, exposure_latency[camera_id].maximum_us);
    1829 } else if (camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_CHDK && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only) {
    1830 struct capture_observation *observation = &image->capture_times.observation;
    1831 observation->earliest_us = capture_started_us;
    1832 observation->latest_us = capture_finished_us;
    1833 observation->kind = CAPTURE_TIME_SHUTTER_WINDOW;
    1834 if (exposure_latency[camera_id].valid && capture_finished_us >= capture_started_us
    1835 && exposure_latency[camera_id].maximum_us <= capture_finished_us - capture_started_us) {
    1836 observation->earliest_us += exposure_latency[camera_id].minimum_us;
    1837 observation->latest_us = capture_started_us + exposure_latency[camera_id].maximum_us;
    1838 observation->kind = CAPTURE_TIME_CALIBRATED_EXPOSURE;
    1839 }
    1840 }
    1841 return filename[0] != '\0';
    1842}
    1843
    1844/** @brief Resolve live pose evidence associated with an acquired image.
    1845 * @param request Original trigger whose photo number is retained.
    1846 * @param[in,out] image Image and timing evidence to qualify.
    1847 * @details Prefer frame-bound timing when available. Wait briefly for a pose
    1848 * bracket, but promote the aligned pose to exposure pose only when the time
    1849 * evidence represents exposure, not merely frame delivery. */
    1850static void resolve_capture_pose(const union dc_shot_union *request, struct captured_image *image)
    1851{
    1852 if (test_capture_enabled || local_capture_only) return;
    1853 struct capture_observation frame = {0};
    1854 if (capture_arbiter_frame_timing(image->filename, image->camera_id, &frame)) image->capture_times.observation = frame;
    1855 struct capture_observation *observation = &image->capture_times.observation;
    1856 image->exposure_pose_valid = false;
    1857 if (!capture_arbiter_observation_pose(observation, 200000)) return;
    1858 observation->pose.data.nr = request->data.nr;
    1859 if (capture_observation_exposure(observation)) {
    1860 image->exposure_shot = observation->pose;
    1861 image->pose_uncertainty_m = observation->pose_uncertainty_m;
    1862 image->exposure_pose_valid = true;
    1863 }
    1864}
    1865
    1866/** @brief Complete publication and metadata before releasing survey ownership.
    1867 * @param shoot Original request, retained as provenance if exposure pose is available.
    1868 * @param[in,out] image Acquired image and its original driver's completion hooks.
    1869 * @details Native completion can wait for a JPEG here without holding the optical
    1870 * lane. Metadata-dependent drivers still call this under their capture ownership.
    1871 * Live analysis is submitted only after saving; local/test callers retain the
    1872 * synchronous behavior expected by their tools and regression fixtures.
    1873 */
    1874static bool finish_image(const union dc_shot_union *shoot, struct captured_image *image)
    1875{
    1876 if (image->pending.acquired) {
    1877 if (!image->backend.capture_ops || !image->backend.capture_ops->finish
    1878 || image->backend.capture_ops->finish(&image->pending, image->filename, sizeof(image->filename), &keep_running) != 0) {
    1879 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, 1U << (image->camera_id - 1));
    1880 return false;
    1881 }
    1882 }
    1883 resolve_capture_pose(shoot, image);
    1884 const union dc_shot_union *request = image->exposure_pose_valid ? shoot : NULL;
    1885 /* Keep both records. Replacing request pose with an exposure estimate must not
    1886 * erase the original evidence or apply the old latency correction a second time. */
    1887 if (image->exposure_pose_valid) shoot = &image->exposure_shot;
    1888 char detection_summary[256];
    1889 const bool object_metadata = (image->backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_DETECTION) != 0;
    1890 if (object_metadata)
    1891 image->backend.bind_frame(image->capture_times.observation.sequence,
    1892 image->capture_times.observation.frame_bound
    1893 ? image->capture_times.observation.sensor_timestamp_ns : 0);
    1894 if (object_metadata) image->backend.detection_summary(detection_summary, sizeof(detection_summary));
    1895 uint64_t metadata_started_us = monotonic_time_us();
    1896 char *filename = image->filename;
    1897 bool image_ready = false;
    1898 {
    1899 if (debug_enabled) {
    1900 printf("USHER-%d DEBUG:\twriting flight metadata to captured JPEG\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1901 }
    1902 const int compensate = motion_compensation_enabled && !image->exposure_pose_valid;
    1903 if (image_exif_write_complete(filename, shoot, image->capture_delay, compensate,
    1904 &image->capture_times, request, image->pose_uncertainty_m,
    1905 object_metadata ? detection_summary : NULL) == 0) {
    1906 image_ready = true;
    1907 printf("USHER-%d:\tShooting: EXIF metadata added\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1908 if (image->backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_GEOLOCATION) {
    1909 if (mock_map_enabled) {
    1910 if (image_exif_write_hotspots(filename,
    1911 "status=unsupported_mock_map; visible_map_texture=true; coordinates_omitted=true") != 0) {
    1912 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to record map mock provenance\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1913 }
    1914 } else if (mock_transform_enabled) {
    1915 if (image_exif_write_hotspots(filename, "status=unsupported_mock_transform; coordinates_omitted=true") != 0) {
    1916 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to record unsupported thermal transform\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1917 }
    1918 } else if (image->backend.geolocate(filename) != 0) {
    1919 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tLWIR hotspot geolocation failed; photo retained\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1920 lwir_mark_backoff();
    1921 if (image_exif_write_hotspots(filename, "status=analysis_failed; coordinates_omitted=true") != 0) {
    1922 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to record hotspot analysis failure\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1923 }
    1924 }
    1925 } else if (object_metadata) {
    1926 /* The detector's result was captured above and included in the
    1927 * same EXIF rewrite. Do not add a second detection-only rewrite here. */
    1928 if (debug_enabled) {
    1929 printf("USHER-%d DEBUG:\tobject detection: %s\n", shoot->data.nr, detection_summary);
    1930 }
    1931 }
    1932 if (mock_map_enabled && image_exif_write_mock_map(filename, mock_map_horizontal_fov,
    1933 mock_map_vertical_fov) != 0) {
    1934 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to record mock map geometry\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1935 image_ready = false;
    1936 }
    1937 if (image_ready && mock_map_enabled && mock_lens_profile &&
    1938 image->camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_AICAM) {
    1939 char derivative[MAX_FILENAME];
    1940 if (!image_lens_emulate("./bin/camera_lens", filename, mock_lens_profile, mock_map_cache,
    1941 derivative, sizeof(derivative), &keep_running)) {
    1942 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tlens emulation failed; clean photo retained, LOOM/SODA skipped\n",
    1943 shoot->data.nr);
    1944 image_ready = false;
    1945 } else {
    1946 const size_t length = strlen(derivative);
    1947 for (size_t index = 0; index <= length; ++index) filename[index] = derivative[index];
    1948 printf("USHER-%d:\tlens-emulated analysis input %s\n", shoot->data.nr, filename);
    1949 }
    1950 }
    1951 if (image_ready && (image->backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_PRIVATE_IMAGE)) {
    1952 const int publication = usher_complete_photo(filename, sizeof(image->filename));
    1953 if (publication < 0) {
    1954 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tphoto publication failed; private capture retained at %s: %s\n",
    1955 shoot->data.nr, filename, strerror(errno));
    1956 image_ready = false;
    1957 } else if (publication > 0) {
    1958 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tphoto published; directory sync or private alias cleanup incomplete: %s\n",
    1959 shoot->data.nr, strerror(errno));
    1960 }
    1961 }
    1962 if (image_ready) {
    1963 printf("Photo take %d\n", shoot->data.nr);
    1964 }
    1965 } else {
    1966 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to add EXIF metadata to %s\n", shoot->data.nr, filename);
    1967 }
    1968 }
    1969
    1970 if (debug_enabled) {
    1971 printf("USHER-%d TIMING:\tcamera=%d metadata_ms=%.3f ready=%d\n",
    1972 shoot->data.nr, image->camera_id,
    1973 (monotonic_time_us() - metadata_started_us) / 1000.0, image_ready);
    1974 }
    1975 capture_arbiter_complete(shoot, image->camera_id, image_ready, image->exposure_pose_valid,
    1976 image->pose_uncertainty_m, monotonic_time_us());
    1977 if (image_ready) {
    1978 if (object_metadata) image->backend.save_detection_copy(filename);
    1979 if (image->backend.image_saved) image->backend.image_saved(filename, shoot);
    1980 bool live_capture = lwir_async_recovery_enabled && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only;
    1981 if (live_capture || (lwir_spotter_enabled() && image->camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM)) {
    1982 defer_saved_analysis(filename, shoot, image->camera_id, &image->capture_times);
    1983 } else {
    1984 uint64_t analysis_started_us = monotonic_time_us();
    1985 int soda_result = run_soda(filename, shoot, image->camera_id);
    1986 printf("USHER-%d:\tShooting: soda return %d of image %s\n",
    1987 shoot->data.nr, soda_result, filename);
    1988 if (debug_enabled) {
    1989 printf("USHER-%d TIMING:\tcamera=%d soda_ms=%.3f result=%d\n",
    1990 shoot->data.nr, image->camera_id,
    1991 (monotonic_time_us() - analysis_started_us) / 1000.0, soda_result);
    1992 }
    1993 }
    1994 }
    1995 return image_ready;
    1996}
    1997
    1998/** @brief Dispatch one complete UART frame without running slow camera work inline.
    1999 * @details The serial event-loop owner calls this once per parsed message. Camera
    2000 * masks are split into independent backend work; EARcam receipt-time tagging is
    2001 * separate from photographic queueing. New protocols must validate lengths and
    2002 * session ownership before causing camera or service side effects.
    2003 */
    2004static void handle_received_message(void)
    2005{
    2006 usher_protocol.msg_received = false;
    2007 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_CONTROL_NEGOTIATE || usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_CONTROL_COMMAND) {
    2008 handle_control_message();
    2009 return;
    2010 }
    2011
    2012 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_CAPTURE_ARBITER_STATE) {
    2013 union usher_capture_arbiter_state_union message;
    2014 if (usher_protocol.payload_len == sizeof(message.bin)) {
    2015 for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(message.bin); ++index) message.bin[index] = usher_protocol.payload[index];
    2016 capture_arbiter_set_scope(&message, serial_receive_monotonic_us);
    2017 }
    2018 return;
    2019 }
    2020 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_CAPTURE_ARBITER_SHOOT) {
    2021 union usher_capture_arbiter_shoot_union message;
    2022 if (usher_protocol.payload_len != sizeof(message.bin)) return;
    2023 for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(message.bin); ++index) message.bin[index] = usher_protocol.payload[index];
    2024 if (message.data.session != capture_arbiter_session_id() || !message.data.session
    2025 || message.data.camera_mask > USHER_CAMERA_MASK_ALL) return;
    2026 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++camera_id) {
    2027 if ((message.data.camera_mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1))) && prepare_session_backend(camera_id))
    2028 camera_owners[camera_id].record(&message.data.shot);
    2029 }
    2030 capture_arbiter_offer(&message, serial_receive_monotonic_us);
    2031 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2032 last_photo_request_us = serial_receive_monotonic_us;
    2033 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2034 return;
    2035 }
    2036
    2037 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_CLOCK_REPLY) {
    2038 if (clock_probes_enabled) {
    2039 if (clock_alignment_reply(&fc_clock, usher_protocol.payload, usher_protocol.payload_len,
    2040 serial_receive_monotonic_us)) ++clock_reply_count;
    2041 else ++clock_rejected_count;
    2042 }
    2043 return;
    2044 }
    2045 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_POSE_CLOCKED) {
    2046 record_clocked_pose();
    2047 return;
    2048 }
    2049 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_POSE_SAMPLE) {
    2050 fc_clock.valid = false;
    2051 capture_arbiter_pose_invalidate();
    2052 pose_log_record(usher_protocol.payload, usher_protocol.payload_len, serial_receive_monotonic_us);
    2053 camera_record_pose(usher_protocol.payload, usher_protocol.payload_len);
    2054 return;
    2055 }
    2056 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_SHOOT_MASK) {
    2057 if (debug_enabled) {
    2058 printf("USHER DEBUG:\tphoto trigger received; decoding shot payload\n");
    2059 }
    2060 union dc_shot_mask_union message;
    2061 if (usher_protocol.payload_len != sizeof(message.bin)) {
    2062 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tinvalid USHER shot payload length %u\n", usher_protocol.payload_len);
    2063 return;
    2064 }
    2065 for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(message.bin); ++index) message.bin[index] = usher_protocol.payload[index];
    2066 const union dc_shot_union *shoot = &message.data.shot;
    2067 if (!message.data.request_id || shoot->data.nr <= 0) return;
    2068 uint32_t camera_mask = message.data.camera_mask;
    2069 if (camera_mask > USHER_CAMERA_MASK_ALL) {
    2070 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tinvalid camera mask %" PRIu32 "\n", camera_mask);
    2071 return;
    2072 }
    2073 if (camera_mask == USHER_CAMERA_MASK_NONE) return;
    2074 for (unsigned camera_id = 6; camera_id <= 8; ++camera_id) {
    2075 if (camera_mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1)))
    2076 queue_shot_result(message.data.request_id, shoot->data.nr, camera_id, USHER_SHOT_UNSUPPORTED);
    2077 }
    2078 camera_mask &= USHER_CAMERA_MASK_SUPPORTED;
    2079 if (!camera_mask) return;
    2080 printf("USHER:\tSHOT %d mask 0x%02" PRIx32 " | lat %.7f lon %.7f | MSL %.1f m AGL %.1f m | "
    2081 "roll %.1f pitch %.1f yaw %.1f deg | speed %.1f m/s course %.1f deg\n",
    2082 shoot->data.nr, camera_mask,
    2083 shoot->data.lat / 1e7,
    2084 shoot->data.lon / 1e7,
    2085 shoot->data.alt / 1000.0,
    2086 shoot->data.groundalt / POSITION_BFP_SCALE,
    2087 shoot->data.phi / ANGLE_BFP_SCALE * RAD_TO_DEG,
    2088 shoot->data.theta / ANGLE_BFP_SCALE * RAD_TO_DEG,
    2089 shoot->data.psi / ANGLE_BFP_SCALE * RAD_TO_DEG,
    2090 shoot->data.vground / SPEED_BFP_SCALE,
    2091 shoot->data.course / ANGLE_BFP_SCALE * RAD_TO_DEG);
    2092
    2093 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++camera_id) {
    2094 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_identity_get(camera_id);
    2095 if ((camera_mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1))) && (backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_POINT_STREAM)) {
    2096 const struct camera_backend *owner = &camera_owners[camera_id];
    2097 const bool recorded = camera_stream_states[camera_id] == CAMERA_STREAM_ACTIVE && owner->record && owner->record(shoot) == 0;
    2098 queue_shot_result(message.data.request_id, shoot->data.nr, camera_id,
    2099 recorded ? USHER_SHOT_RECORDED : USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2100 continue;
    2101 }
    2102 if (!(camera_mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1))) || !(backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_POINT_SESSION)) continue;
    2103 bool recorded = false;
    2104 if (prepare_session_backend(camera_id)) {
    2105 const struct camera_backend *owner = &camera_owners[camera_id];
    2106 recorded = owner->session->listening() && owner->record(shoot) == 0;
    2107 }
    2108 queue_shot_result(message.data.request_id, shoot->data.nr, camera_id,
    2109 recorded ? USHER_SHOT_RECORDED : USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2110 }
    2111 if ((camera_mask & (USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK | USHER_CAMERA_MASK_AICAM | USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR)) != 0) {
    2112 start_shoot_worker(shoot, (uint8_t)camera_mask, message.data.request_id);
    2113 }
    2114 } else if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_STOP_TARGETED || usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_START_TARGETED) {
    2115 if (usher_protocol.payload_len != USHER_STOP_TARGETED_MSG_SIZE) {
    2116 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tinvalid USHER session payload length %u\n", usher_protocol.payload_len);
    2117 return;
    2118 }
    2119 union usher_camera_session_union command;
    2120 for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof(command.bin); ++index) {
    2121 command.bin[index] = usher_protocol.payload[index];
    2122 }
    2123 if (command.data.camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID || !command.data.session_id) return;
    2124 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_START_TARGETED) {
    2125 handle_targeted_start(command.data.camera_id, command.data.session_id);
    2126 } else {
    2127 handle_targeted_stop(command.data.camera_id, command.data.session_id);
    2128 }
    2129 } else if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_BUFFER_EMPTY) {
    2130 send_msg_image_buffer();
    2131 }
    2132}
    2133
    2134/** @brief Ensure a point-session backend has a registered owner.
    2135 * @param camera_id Protocol camera ID.
    2136 * @return True once a complete session backend is initialized.
    2137 * @details Check all lifecycle hooks before initialization and reuse an
    2138 * existing owner rather than reopening a session-capable device. */
    2139static bool prepare_session_backend(unsigned camera_id)
    2140{
    2141 if (camera_id < 1 || camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID) return false;
    2142 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_identity_get(camera_id);
    2143 const struct camera_session_ops *ops = backend.session;
    2144 if (!(backend.capabilities & CAMERA_CAP_POINT_SESSION) || !ops || !ops->start || !ops->stop
    2145 || !ops->listening || !ops->completion_fd || !ops->poll_result || !ops->drain
    2146 || !backend.init || !backend.deinit || !backend.record) return false;
    2147 if (camera_initialized[camera_id]) return true;
    2148 const struct camera_backend_host host = {.running = &keep_running,
    2149 .pose_lookup = capture_arbiter_observation_pose, .queue_analysis = defer_soda
    2150 };
    2151 if (backend.configure) backend.configure(&host);
    2152 if (backend.init(NULL) != 0) {
    2153 backend.deinit();
    2154 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\t%s not available; other cameras remain active\n", backend.name);
    2155 return false;
    2156 }
    2157 camera_owners[camera_id] = backend;
    2158 camera_initialized[camera_id] = true;
    2159 return true;
    2160}
    2161
    2162/** @brief Resolve runtime routing without mutating the global selected backend.
    2163 * @param camera_id Protocol camera identity.
    2164 * @return Driver type, including configured AI detection and local overrides.
    2165 */
    2166static enum camera_backend_type camera_type_for_id(int camera_id)
    2167{
    2168 return camera_backend_registry_route(camera_id, configured_camera_backend, local_capture_only);
    2169}
    2170
    2171/** @brief Select and lazily initialize a backend under the caller's camera ownership.
    2172 * @param camera_id Image-camera identity, not a mask.
    2173 * @return Zero when ready, negative on invalid input, shutdown or backend failure.
    2174 * @details A failed optional camera must not stop the other bits of a mixed request.
    2175 */
    2176static int camera_prepare(int camera_id)
    2177{
    2178 if (!usher_running() || camera_id < USHER_CAMERA_CHDK || camera_id > USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM) return -1;
    2179 const enum camera_backend_type type = camera_type_for_id(camera_id);
    2180 if (camera_backend_select(type, test_capture_enabled) != 0) return -1;
    2181 optical_camera_id = camera_id;
    2182 if (camera_initialized[camera_id]) {
    2183 const struct camera_backend *owner = &camera_owners[camera_id];
    2184 if (owner->init != camera.init || owner->shoot != camera.shoot || owner->deinit != camera.deinit
    2185 || owner->capture_ops != camera.capture_ops || owner->capabilities != camera.capabilities
    2186 || owner->point_stream != camera.point_stream || owner->image_saved != camera.image_saved
    2187 || owner->prefix != camera.prefix) {
    2188 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tcamera id %d backend change requires completed teardown\n", camera_id);
    2189 return -1;
    2190 }
    2191 camera = *owner;
    2192 return 0;
    2193 }
    2194 if (camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM && camera_unavailable[camera_id]) {
    2195 uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2196 if (now_us == 0 || now_us < lwir_retry_after_us) return -1;
    2197 camera_unavailable[camera_id] = false;
    2198 printf("USHER:\tretrying LWIR camera after unavailable cooldown\n");
    2199 }
    2200 if (camera_register_stream(&camera) != 0) return -1;
    2201 const struct camera_backend_host host = {.running = &keep_running,
    2202 .pose_lookup = capture_arbiter_observation_pose, .queue_analysis = defer_soda};
    2203 if (camera.configure) camera.configure(&host);
    2204 if (camera.init(camera_source_image) != 0) {
    2205 camera.deinit();
    2206 if (camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM) lwir_mark_backoff();
    2207 if (!camera_warned[camera_id]) {
    2208 camera_warned[camera_id] = true;
    2209 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\t%s (camera id %d) not available; continuing without it\n",
    2210 camera.name, camera_id);
    2211 } else if (debug_enabled) {
    2212 printf("USHER DEBUG:\t%s (camera id %d) still not available\n", camera.name, camera_id);
    2213 }
    2214 return -1;
    2215 }
    2216 camera_warned[camera_id] = false;
    2217 if (camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM) {
    2218 camera_unavailable[camera_id] = false;
    2219 lwir_retry_after_us = 0;
    2220 }
    2221 if (!camera.point_stream) camera_owners[camera_id] = camera;
    2222 camera_initialized[camera_id] = true;
    2223 printf("USHER:\tactive camera backend: %s (id %d)\n", camera.name, optical_camera_id);
    2224 return 0;
    2225}
    2226
    2227/** @brief Rate-limit thermal recovery so a missing USB camera does not consume every request. */
    2228static void lwir_mark_backoff(void)
    2229{
    2230 uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2231 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2232 camera_initialized[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = false;
    2233 camera_unavailable[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = true;
    2234 lwir_retry_after_us = now_us == 0 || now_us > UINT64_MAX - LWIR_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US
    2235 ? UINT64_MAX : now_us + LWIR_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US;
    2236 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2237}
    2238
    2239/** @brief Retry thermal startup outside both UART reception and the optical lane.
    2240 * @param unused Unused pthread argument.
    2241 * @return NULL after recovery or shutdown; completion state is signalled under mut.
    2242 */
    2243static void *recover_lwir_camera(void *unused)
    2244{
    2245 (void)unused;
    2246 bool retrying = false;
    2247 while (usher_running()) {
    2248 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2249 uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2250 bool cooling_down = camera_unavailable[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM]
    2251 && (now_us == 0 || now_us < lwir_retry_after_us);
    2252 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2253 if (cooling_down) {
    2254 sleep_microseconds(LWIR_RETRY_POLL_US);
    2255 continue;
    2256 }
    2257 if (retrying) printf("USHER:\tretrying LWIR camera after unavailable cooldown\n");
    2258
    2259 pthread_mutex_lock(&lwir_camera_mutex);
    2260 if (!usher_running()) {
    2261 pthread_mutex_unlock(&lwir_camera_mutex);
    2262 break;
    2263 }
    2264 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_backend_get(CAMERA_BACKEND_LWIR_CAM);
    2265 int result = backend.init_cancelable(NULL, &keep_running);
    2266 if (result == 0 && !usher_running()) result = -1;
    2267 if (result != 0) backend.deinit();
    2268 pthread_mutex_unlock(&lwir_camera_mutex);
    2269
    2270 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2271 if (result == 0) {
    2272 camera_owners[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = backend;
    2273 camera_initialized[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = true;
    2274 camera_unavailable[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = false;
    2275 camera_warned[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = false;
    2276 lwir_retry_after_us = 0;
    2277 lwir_recovery_in_progress = false;
    2278 printf("USHER:\tactive camera backend: lwircam (id %d)\n", USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM);
    2279 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2280 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2281 return NULL;
    2282 }
    2283 camera_initialized[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = false;
    2284 camera_unavailable[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = true;
    2285 now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2286 lwir_retry_after_us = now_us == 0 || now_us > UINT64_MAX - LWIR_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US
    2287 ? UINT64_MAX : now_us + LWIR_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US;
    2288 if (!camera_warned[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM]) {
    2289 camera_warned[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM] = true;
    2290 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tlwircam (camera id %d) not available; AIcam remains active\n",
    2291 USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM);
    2292 }
    2293 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2294 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2295 retrying = true;
    2296 }
    2297
    2298 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2299 lwir_recovery_in_progress = false;
    2300 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2301 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2302 return NULL;
    2303}
    2304
    2305/** @brief Check thermal readiness or start at most one background recovery attempt.
    2306 * @return True only when already initialized; false does not mean recovery is finished.
    2307 */
    2308static bool lwir_ready_or_start_recovery(void)
    2309{
    2310 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2311 if (camera_initialized[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM]) {
    2312 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2313 return true;
    2314 }
    2315 if (!usher_running() || lwir_recovery_in_progress) {
    2316 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2317 return false;
    2318 }
    2319 lwir_recovery_in_progress = true;
    2320 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2321
    2322 pthread_t recovery_thread;
    2323 int thread_result = pthread_create(&recovery_thread, NULL, recover_lwir_camera, NULL);
    2324 if (thread_result != 0) {
    2325 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2326 lwir_recovery_in_progress = false;
    2327 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2328 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2329 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tfailed to start LWIR recovery: %s\n", strerror(thread_result));
    2330 lwir_mark_backoff();
    2331 return false;
    2332 }
    2333 pthread_detach(recovery_thread);
    2334 return false;
    2335}
    2336
    2337/** @brief Admit an optional stream once per owner, without opening its sensor.
    2338 * @details Failed optional startup is cleaned up once and does not disable photos.
    2339 * Changing profiles requires teardown, even before the first sensor acquisition.
    2340 */
    2341static int camera_register_stream(const struct camera_backend *backend)
    2342{
    2343 if (!backend || backend->camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID) return -1;
    2344 const unsigned camera_id = backend->camera_id;
    2345 if (camera_stream_states[camera_id] != CAMERA_STREAM_CLOSED
    2346 && camera_owners[camera_id].point_stream != backend->point_stream) return -1;
    2347 if (!backend->point_stream) return 0;
    2348 if (!camera_id || camera_stream_states[camera_id] == CAMERA_STREAM_DRAINED) return -1;
    2349 if (camera_initialized[camera_id] && camera_owners[camera_id].point_stream != backend->point_stream) return -1;
    2350 if (camera_stream_states[camera_id] != CAMERA_STREAM_CLOSED) return 0;
    2351 camera_owners[camera_id] = *backend;
    2352 const struct camera_point_stream_ops *stream = backend->point_stream;
    2353 if (stream->init && stream->init() != 0) {
    2354 camera_stream_states[camera_id] = CAMERA_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE;
    2355 if (stream->drain) stream->drain();
    2356 } else camera_stream_states[camera_id] = CAMERA_STREAM_ACTIVE;
    2357 return 0;
    2358}
    2359
    2360/** @brief Withdraw one backend from service and release its resources.
    2361 * @param camera_id Owner slot, including the default slot.
    2362 * @details Clear dispatch state, drain an active point stream, then release
    2363 * the initialized backend. Clear its result caches before the slot is reused. */
    2364static void camera_close_owner(unsigned camera_id)
    2365{
    2366 if (camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID) return;
    2367 const struct camera_backend owner = camera_owners[camera_id];
    2368 const bool initialized = camera_initialized[camera_id];
    2369 const bool stream_active = camera_stream_states[camera_id] == CAMERA_STREAM_ACTIVE;
    2370 camera_stream_states[camera_id] = CAMERA_STREAM_CLOSED;
    2371 camera_owners[camera_id] = (struct camera_backend) {0};
    2372 camera_initialized[camera_id] = false;
    2373 if (stream_active && owner.point_stream && owner.point_stream->drain) owner.point_stream->drain();
    2374 if (owner.point_stream && camera_id) {
    2375 memset(&point_sessions[camera_id - 1], 0, sizeof(point_sessions[camera_id - 1]));
    2376 point_update_pending[camera_id - 1] = false;
    2377 }
    2378 if (initialized && owner.deinit) owner.deinit();
    2379}
    2380
    2381/** @brief Tear down registered cameras and independently owned analysis workers.
    2382 * @details Walk the owner registry first, then stop auxiliary workers whose
    2383 * lifetime is not completely represented by a registry slot. */
    2384static void cameras_deinit(void)
    2385{
    2386 for (unsigned camera_id = USHER_CAMERA_ALL; camera_id <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++camera_id)
    2387 camera_close_owner(camera_id);
    2388 spotter_cam_pipe_deinit();
    2389 lwir_spotter_stop();
    2390 const struct camera_backend loom_capture = loom_camera_backend_get(false);
    2391 if (loom_capture.deinit) loom_capture.deinit();
    2392}
    2393
    2394/** @brief Own thermal capture and its last-frame metadata independently of optical work.
    2395 * @param pointer Pool-owned request, released after capture handling.
    2396 * @return NULL after releasing the thermal in-progress flag.
    2397 */
    2398static void *handle_lwir_shoot(void *pointer)
    2399{
    2400 struct capture_job *job = pointer;
    2401 pthread_mutex_lock(&lwir_camera_mutex);
    2402 bool saved = false;
    2403 if (usher_running()) {
    2404 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_owners[USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM];
    2405 struct captured_image image;
    2406 if (capture_image(&job->shot, &image, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, &backend)) {
    2407 saved = finish_image(&job->shot, &image);
    2408 }
    2409 lwir_ready_or_start_recovery();
    2410 }
    2411 pthread_mutex_unlock(&lwir_camera_mutex);
    2412 queue_shot_result(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM,
    2413 saved ? USHER_SHOT_SAVED : USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2414 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2415 capture_job_release_locked(job);
    2416 lwir_capture_in_progress = false;
    2417 const bool pending = waiting_lwir.valid;
    2418 lwir_handoff_in_progress = pending;
    2419 const union dc_shot_union next_shot = pending ? waiting_lwir.shot : (union dc_shot_union) {0};
    2420 const uint32_t next_request_id = pending ? waiting_lwir.request_id : 0;
    2421 const uint64_t received_us = pending ? waiting_lwir.received_us : 0;
    2422 waiting_lwir.valid = false;
    2423 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2424 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2425 if (pending) {
    2426 const uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2427 if (usher_running() && now_us >= received_us && now_us - received_us <= LWIR_WAIT_MAX_US)
    2428 start_lwir_worker(&next_shot, next_request_id, received_us);
    2429 else {
    2430 capture_arbiter_failed(&next_shot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR);
    2431 queue_shot_result(next_request_id, next_shot.data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2432 }
    2433 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2434 lwir_handoff_in_progress = false;
    2435 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2436 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2437 }
    2438 return NULL;
    2439}
    2440
    2441/** @brief Dispatch a single-flight thermal request without waiting for USB recovery.
    2442 * @param[in] shoot Request copied into worker-owned storage on admission.
    2443 * @param[in] request_id Correlation ID returned to the flight controller; distinct from photo number.
    2444 * @param[in] received_us Monotonic time when the request was admitted, used to reject stale queued work.
    2445 * @details This function is called by the serial owner. Failed admission releases
    2446 * matching survey ownership so a missing thermal camera cannot remain permanently busy.
    2447 */
    2448static void start_lwir_worker(const union dc_shot_union *shoot, uint32_t request_id, uint64_t received_us)
    2449{
    2450 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2451 if (!usher_running()) {
    2452 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2453 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2454 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR);
    2455 queue_shot_result(request_id, shoot->data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2456 return;
    2457 }
    2458 if (lwir_capture_in_progress) {
    2459 ++lwir_busy_skipped_count;
    2460 if (lwir_active_received_us > received_us
    2461 || (waiting_lwir.valid && waiting_lwir.received_us > received_us)) {
    2462 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2463 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR);
    2464 queue_shot_result(request_id, shoot->data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, USHER_SHOT_SUPERSEDED);
    2465 return;
    2466 }
    2467 const bool replaced = waiting_lwir.valid;
    2468 const union dc_shot_union old_shot = replaced ? waiting_lwir.shot : (union dc_shot_union) {0};
    2469 const uint32_t old_request_id = replaced ? waiting_lwir.request_id : 0;
    2470 waiting_lwir.shot = *shoot;
    2471 waiting_lwir.request_id = request_id;
    2472 waiting_lwir.received_us = received_us;
    2473 waiting_lwir.valid = true;
    2474 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2475 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2476 if (replaced) {
    2477 capture_arbiter_failed(&old_shot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR);
    2478 queue_shot_result(old_request_id, old_shot.data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, USHER_SHOT_SUPERSEDED);
    2479 }
    2480 return;
    2481 }
    2482 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2483 if (!lwir_ready_or_start_recovery()) {
    2484 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR);
    2485 queue_shot_result(request_id, shoot->data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2486 return;
    2487 }
    2488 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2489 struct capture_job *job = capture_job_acquire_locked();
    2490 if (job == NULL) {
    2491 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2492 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tLWIR job pool is full\n", shoot->data.nr);
    2493 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR);
    2494 queue_shot_result(request_id, shoot->data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2495 return;
    2496 }
    2497 job->shot = *shoot;
    2498 job->request_id = request_id;
    2499 lwir_active_received_us = received_us;
    2500 lwir_capture_in_progress = true;
    2501 pthread_t worker;
    2502 int result = pthread_create(&worker, NULL, handle_lwir_shoot, job);
    2503 if (result != 0) {
    2504 lwir_capture_in_progress = false;
    2505 capture_job_release_locked(job);
    2506 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to start LWIR worker: %s\n", shoot->data.nr, strerror(result));
    2507 } else {
    2508 pthread_detach(worker);
    2509 }
    2510 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2511 if (result != 0) {
    2512 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR);
    2513 queue_shot_result(request_id, shoot->data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2514 }
    2515}
    2516
    2517/** @brief Pause new CHDK attempts after a failed request; the caller holds mut. */
    2518static void chdk_start_cooldown_locked(void)
    2519{
    2520 const uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2521 chdk_retry_after_us = now_us && now_us <= UINT64_MAX - CHDK_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US
    2522 ? now_us + CHDK_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US : UINT64_MAX;
    2523}
    2524
    2525/** @brief Write metadata for one captured CHDK image after the camera lane was released.
    2526 * @param pointer Unused; the single-flight job lives in chdk_finish.
    2527 * @return NULL after reporting the result and clearing the finisher flag. */
    2528static void *handle_chdk_finish(void *pointer)
    2529{
    2530 (void)pointer;
    2531 const bool saved = finish_image(&chdk_finish.job.shot, &chdk_finish.image);
    2532 if (!saved && usher_running())
    2533 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d: CHDK request failed; new CHDK attempts paused for %.3f s; other camera lanes remain independent\n",
    2534 chdk_finish.job.shot.data.nr, CHDK_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US / 1e6);
    2535 queue_shot_result(chdk_finish.job.request_id, chdk_finish.job.shot.data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_CHDK,
    2536 saved ? USHER_SHOT_SAVED : USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2537 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2538 if (!saved) chdk_start_cooldown_locked();
    2539 chdk_finish_in_progress = false;
    2540 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2541 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2542 return NULL;
    2543}
    2544
    2545/** @brief Hand a captured image to the finisher, waiting if the previous one is still writing.
    2546 * @return False when no finisher thread could start; the caller then finishes the image inline. */
    2547static bool start_chdk_finish(const struct capture_job *job, const struct captured_image *image)
    2548{
    2549 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2550 while (chdk_finish_in_progress) pthread_cond_wait(&workers_finished, &mut);
    2551 chdk_finish.job = *job;
    2552 chdk_finish.image = *image;
    2553 chdk_finish_in_progress = true;
    2554 pthread_attr_t attributes;
    2555 int result = pthread_attr_init(&attributes);
    2556 const bool attributes_ready = result == 0;
    2557 if (!result) result = pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attributes, 256U * 1024U);
    2558 if (!result) result = pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attributes, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
    2559 pthread_t worker;
    2560 if (!result) result = pthread_create(&worker, &attributes, handle_chdk_finish, NULL);
    2561 if (attributes_ready) pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
    2562 if (result) {
    2563 chdk_finish_in_progress = false;
    2564 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2565 }
    2566 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2567 if (result) fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d: unable to start CHDK finisher: %s; finishing inline\n",
    2568 job->shot.data.nr, strerror(result));
    2569 return result == 0;
    2570}
    2571
    2572/** @brief Capture one CHDK request and release the camera lane before metadata is written.
    2573 * @param pointer Dedicated single-flight request storage, retained until the capture ends.
    2574 * @return NULL after teardown and signalling worker completion.
    2575 * @details A captured image moves to handle_chdk_finish(), which owns the shot result,
    2576 * so EXIF and publication overlap the next camera operation. */
    2577static void *handle_chdk_shoot(void *pointer)
    2578{
    2579 const struct capture_job *job = pointer;
    2580 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_backend_get(camera_type_for_id(USHER_CAMERA_CHDK));
    2581 bool saved = false;
    2582 bool handed_off = false;
    2583 bool initialized = false;
    2584 if (usher_running()) {
    2585 const struct camera_backend_host host = {.running = &keep_running,
    2586 .pose_lookup = capture_arbiter_observation_pose, .queue_analysis = defer_soda};
    2587 if (backend.configure) backend.configure(&host);
    2588 initialized = backend.init && backend.init(camera_source_image) == 0;
    2589 if (initialized) {
    2590 struct captured_image image;
    2591 if (capture_image(&job->shot, &image, USHER_CAMERA_CHDK, &backend)) {
    2592 handed_off = start_chdk_finish(job, &image);
    2593 if (!handed_off) saved = finish_image(&job->shot, &image);
    2594 }
    2595 }
    2596 }
    2597 if (backend.deinit) backend.deinit();
    2598 if (!initialized) capture_arbiter_failed(&job->shot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK);
    2599 if (!saved && !handed_off) {
    2600 if (usher_running())
    2601 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d: CHDK request failed; new CHDK attempts paused for %.3f s; other camera lanes remain independent\n",
    2602 job->shot.data.nr, CHDK_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US / 1e6);
    2603 queue_shot_result(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_CHDK, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2604 } else if (saved) {
    2605 queue_shot_result(job->request_id, job->shot.data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_CHDK, USHER_SHOT_SAVED);
    2606 }
    2607 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2608 if (saved || handed_off) chdk_retry_after_us = 0;
    2609 else chdk_start_cooldown_locked();
    2610 chdk_capture_in_progress = false;
    2611 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2612 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2613 return NULL;
    2614}
    2615
    2616/** @brief Resolve the currently advertised control capabilities.
    2617 * @param camera_id Protocol camera ID.
    2618 * @return Supported command bits, or zero when controls are unavailable.
    2619 * @details Advertise physical lens operations only when the asynchronous
    2620 * CHDK lane and its required hooks are available, never in mock capture modes. */
    2621static uint32_t camera_control_capabilities(uint8_t camera_id)
    2622{
    2623 if (camera_id != USHER_CAMERA_CHDK || !chdk_async_capture_enabled || test_capture_enabled
    2624 || local_capture_only || mock_map_enabled) return 0;
    2625 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_identity_get(camera_id);
    2626 return backend.control && backend.control_init ? backend.control_capabilities : 0;
    2627}
    2628
    2629/** @brief Stage a worker's result for serial transmission.
    2630 * @param result Completion including its original request identity.
    2631 * @details Update only a matching session and request slot so late work
    2632 * cannot overwrite state from a renewed control session. */
    2633static void queue_control_result(const struct usher_control_result *result)
    2634{
    2635 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2636 if (result->request.session == control_session && result->camera_id >= 1 && result->camera_id <= 8) {
    2637 const size_t index = result->camera_id - 1;
    2638 if (control_results[index].result.request.request_id == result->request.request_id) {
    2639 control_results[index].result = *result;
    2640 control_results[index].dirty = true;
    2641 }
    2642 }
    2643 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2644 wake_event_loop();
    2645}
    2646
    2647/** @brief Pass dirty control receipts to the UART transmit queue.
    2648 * @details Clear a slot's dirty flag only after successful queue admission;
    2649 * preserve the cached receipt for duplicate requests. */
    2650static void flush_control_results(void)
    2651{
    2652 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2653 for (size_t index = 0; index < 8; ++index) {
    2654 if (!control_results[index].dirty) continue;
    2655 uint8_t bytes[USHER_CONTROL_RESULT_SIZE];
    2656 if (usher_control_encode_result(bytes, sizeof(bytes), &control_results[index].result)
    2657 && serial_tx_send(USHER_CONTROL_RESULT, bytes, sizeof(bytes)) == 0) control_results[index].dirty = false;
    2658 }
    2659 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2660}
    2661
    2662/** @brief Execute an admitted lens command away from the serial owner.
    2663 * @param pointer Address of the request in the reserved CHDK control slot.
    2664 * @return NULL after releasing the CHDK lane.
    2665 * @details Copy the job, execute under exclusive device ownership and report
    2666 * observation evidence only for applied controls. An unsuccessful operation
    2667 * sets a cooldown before another command or capture may use the lane. */
    2668static void *handle_chdk_control(void *pointer)
    2669{
