    2670 const struct usher_control_request request = *(const struct usher_control_request *)pointer;
    2671 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_identity_get(USHER_CAMERA_CHDK);
    2672 struct usher_control_result result = {.request = request, .camera_id = USHER_CAMERA_CHDK,
    2673 .status = CAM_CONTROL_FAILED};
    2674 if (usher_running()) {
    2675 const struct camera_backend_host host = {.running = &keep_running};
    2676 if (backend.configure) backend.configure(&host);
    2677 if (backend.control_init && backend.control && backend.control_init() == 0)
    2678 result.status = backend.control(request.command, request.value, &result.observed, &result.evidence);
    2679 }
    2680 if (backend.deinit) backend.deinit();
    2681 if (result.status != CAM_CONTROL_APPLIED) result.evidence = CAM_CONTROL_EVIDENCE_NONE;
    2682 queue_control_result(&result);
    2683 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2684 const uint64_t now = monotonic_time_us();
    2685 chdk_retry_after_us = result.status == CAM_CONTROL_APPLIED ? 0 : now && now <= UINT64_MAX - CHDK_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US
    2686 ? now + CHDK_RETRY_COOLDOWN_US : UINT64_MAX;
    2687 chdk_capture_in_progress = false;
    2688 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2689 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2690 return NULL;
    2691}
    2692
    2693/** @brief Admit a control into the exclusive CHDK lane under @c mut.
    2694 * @param request Validated command to copy into the reserved slot.
    2695 * @param now Current local monotonic time in microseconds.
    2696 * @return False for busy, cooldown, or shutdown; true if handled, even if worker creation fails.
    2697 * @details Claim the same lane used by CHDK capture. If spawn fails, release
    2698 * the lane and stage a failure receipt rather than leaving a pending request. */
    2699static bool admit_chdk_control_locked(const struct usher_control_request *request, uint64_t now)
    2700{
    2701 if (!usher_running() || chdk_capture_in_progress || now < chdk_retry_after_us) return false;
    2702 chdk_control_job = *request;
    2703 chdk_capture_in_progress = true;
    2704 pthread_attr_t attributes;
    2705 int error = pthread_attr_init(&attributes);
    2706 bool initialized = error == 0;
    2707 if (!error) error = pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attributes, 256U * 1024U);
    2708 if (!error) error = pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attributes, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
    2709 pthread_t worker;
    2710 if (!error) error = pthread_create(&worker, &attributes, handle_chdk_control, &chdk_control_job);
    2711 if (initialized) pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
    2712 if (error) {
    2713 chdk_capture_in_progress = false;
    2714 control_results[0].result.status = CAM_CONTROL_FAILED;
    2715 control_results[0].dirty = true;
    2716 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2717 }
    2718 return true;
    2719}
    2720
    2721/** @brief Establish or renew a camera-control lease from the current UART message.
    2722 * @details Pair a fresh session with the peer's nonce, report available
    2723 * capabilities, and require a timely matching echo before accepting commands.
    2724 * Replacing the session clears old receipt and ordering state. */
    2725static void negotiate_camera_controls(void)
    2726{
    2727 const uint8_t *bytes = usher_protocol.payload;
    2728 uint32_t nonce, requested_session;
    2729 if (usher_protocol.payload_len != USHER_CONTROL_NEGOTIATE_SIZE || bytes[0] != USHER_CONTROL_VERSION
    2730 || !usher_control_get_u32(bytes, usher_protocol.payload_len, 1, &nonce) || !nonce
    2731 || !usher_control_get_u32(bytes, usher_protocol.payload_len, 5, &requested_session)) return;
    2732 const uint64_t now = monotonic_time_us();
    2733 if (!now) return;
    2734 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2735 if (!requested_session) {
    2736 uint32_t fresh = 0;
    2737 ssize_t count = getrandom(&fresh, sizeof(fresh), GRND_NONBLOCK);
    2738 if (count != (ssize_t)sizeof(fresh) || !fresh || fresh == control_session) {
    2739 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2740 return;
    2741 }
    2742 control_session = fresh;
    2743 control_confirmed = false;
    2744 control_nonce = nonce;
    2745 control_high_water = 0;
    2746 for (size_t index = 0; index < 8; ++index) {
    2747 control_results[index].result = (struct usher_control_result){0};
    2748 control_results[index].dirty = false;
    2749 }
    2750 }
    2751 if (!control_session || nonce != control_nonce) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut); return; }
    2752 if (requested_session == control_session && now - control_negotiated_us < USHER_CONTROL_LEASE_US)
    2753 control_confirmed = true;
    2754 else if (requested_session == control_session) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut); return; }
    2755 if (!requested_session || requested_session == control_session) control_negotiated_us = now;
    2756 uint8_t hello[USHER_CONTROL_HELLO_SIZE] = {USHER_CONTROL_VERSION};
    2757 usher_control_put_u32(hello, sizeof(hello), 1, nonce);
    2758 usher_control_put_u32(hello, sizeof(hello), 5, control_session);
    2759 for (uint8_t camera_id = 1; camera_id <= 8; ++camera_id)
    2760 usher_control_put_u32(hello, sizeof(hello), 9 + 4 * (camera_id - 1), camera_control_capabilities(camera_id));
    2761 serial_tx_send(USHER_CONTROL_HELLO, hello, sizeof(hello));
    2762 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2763}
    2764
    2765/** @brief Process negotiation or dispatch an addressed control request.
    2766 * @details Require an active confirmed lease. A request at or below the
    2767 * session high-water mark cannot run again: report the matching cached
    2768 * result when available, or report an unknown outcome. */
    2769static void handle_control_message(void)
    2770{
    2771 if (usher_protocol.msg_id == USHER_CONTROL_NEGOTIATE) { negotiate_camera_controls(); return; }
    2772 struct usher_control_request request;
    2773 if (!usher_control_decode_request(usher_protocol.payload, usher_protocol.payload_len, &request)) return;
    2774 const uint64_t now = monotonic_time_us();
    2775 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2776 if (!usher_running() || !control_confirmed || !now || request.session != control_session
    2777 || now - control_negotiated_us >= USHER_CONTROL_LEASE_US) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut); return; }
    2778 const bool duplicate = request.request_id <= control_high_water;
    2779 if (!duplicate) control_high_water = request.request_id;
    2780 for (uint8_t camera_id = 1; camera_id <= 8; ++camera_id) {
    2781 if (!(request.camera_mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1)))) continue;
    2782 const size_t index = camera_id - 1;
    2783 if (duplicate) {
    2784 const struct usher_control_result *cached = &control_results[index].result;
    2785 if (cached->request.request_id == request.request_id && cached->request.command == request.command
    2786 && cached->request.value == request.value && cached->request.camera_mask == request.camera_mask) {
    2787 if (cached->status != CAM_CONTROL_PENDING) control_results[index].dirty = true;
    2788 } else {
    2789 const struct usher_control_result unknown = {.request = request, .camera_id = camera_id,
    2790 .status = CAM_CONTROL_UNKNOWN};
    2791 uint8_t bytes[USHER_CONTROL_RESULT_SIZE];
    2792 if (usher_control_encode_result(bytes, sizeof(bytes), &unknown)) serial_tx_send(USHER_CONTROL_RESULT, bytes, sizeof(bytes));
    2793 }
    2794 continue;
    2795 }
    2796 if (control_results[index].result.status == CAM_CONTROL_PENDING) {
    2797 const struct usher_control_result busy = {.request = request, .camera_id = camera_id, .status = CAM_CONTROL_BUSY};
    2798 uint8_t bytes[USHER_CONTROL_RESULT_SIZE];
    2799 if (usher_control_encode_result(bytes, sizeof(bytes), &busy)) serial_tx_send(USHER_CONTROL_RESULT, bytes, sizeof(bytes));
    2800 continue;
    2801 }
    2802 control_results[index].result = (struct usher_control_result){.request = request, .camera_id = camera_id,
    2803 .status = CAM_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED};
    2804 control_results[index].dirty = true;
    2805 const uint32_t capabilities = camera_control_capabilities(camera_id);
    2806 if (request.command >= 32 || !(capabilities & CAM_CONTROL_CAP(request.command))) continue;
    2807 if (!usher_control_value_valid(request.command, request.value)) {
    2808 control_results[index].result.status = CAM_CONTROL_INVALID_VALUE;
    2809 continue;
    2810 }
    2811 if (admit_chdk_control_locked(&request, now)) {
    2812 if (control_results[index].result.status != CAM_CONTROL_FAILED) {
    2813 control_results[index].result.status = CAM_CONTROL_PENDING;
    2814 control_results[index].dirty = false;
    2815 }
    2816 } else control_results[index].result.status = CAM_CONTROL_BUSY;
    2817 }
    2818 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2819}
    2820
    2821/** @brief Schedule a shot on CHDK's independent capture lane.
    2822 * @param shoot Trigger copied into the lane's single job slot.
    2823 * @param request_id Correlation ID, or zero for an unacknowledged request.
    2824 * @return True when the detached worker was started.
    2825 * @details Share admission with lens control. Release survey admission and
    2826 * report failure if shutdown, cooldown, contention, or thread setup prevents a shot. */
    2827static bool start_chdk_worker(const union dc_shot_union *shoot, uint32_t request_id)
    2828{
    2829 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2830 uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2831 if (!usher_running() || chdk_capture_in_progress || !now_us || now_us < chdk_retry_after_us) {
    2832 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2833 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK);
    2834 queue_shot_result(request_id, shoot->data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_CHDK, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2835 return false;
    2836 }
    2837 chdk_capture_job = (struct capture_job){.shot = *shoot, .request_id = request_id,
    2838 .camera_mask = USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK, .received_us = now_us};
    2839 chdk_capture_in_progress = true;
    2840 pthread_attr_t attributes;
    2841 int result = pthread_attr_init(&attributes);
    2842 bool attributes_ready = result == 0;
    2843 if (!result) result = pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attributes, 256U * 1024U);
    2844 if (!result) result = pthread_attr_setdetachstate(&attributes, PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);
    2845 pthread_t worker;
    2846 if (!result) result = pthread_create(&worker, &attributes, handle_chdk_shoot, &chdk_capture_job);
    2847 if (attributes_ready) pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
    2848 if (result) {
    2849 chdk_capture_in_progress = false;
    2850 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    2851 }
    2852 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2853 if (result) {
    2854 fprintf(stderr, "USHER: unable to start CHDK worker: %s; other cameras remain active\n", strerror(result));
    2855 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK);
    2856 queue_shot_result(request_id, shoot->data.nr, USHER_CAMERA_CHDK, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2857 }
    2858 return result == 0;
    2859}
    2860
    2861/** @brief Dispatch admitted image bits while preserving bounded legacy/local policies.
    2862 * @param shoot Request to copy; the caller need not retain its storage.
    2863 * @param camera_mask Selected image cameras; live CHDK and LWIR have independent lanes.
    2864 * @param request_id Per-request reply identity, distinct from the photo number.
    2865 * @details Survey jobs retain their ledger ownership; local/test jobs stay FIFO. */
    2866static void start_shoot_worker(const union dc_shot_union *shoot, uint8_t camera_mask, uint32_t request_id)
    2867{
    2868 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2869 last_photo_request_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2870 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2871 const bool live_capture = lwir_async_recovery_enabled && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only;
    2872 bool chdk_admitted = false;
    2873 if (chdk_async_capture_enabled && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only && !mock_map_enabled) {
    2874 if (camera_mask & USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK) chdk_admitted = start_chdk_worker(shoot, request_id);
    2875 camera_mask &= ~USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK;
    2876 }
    2877 if (chdk_admitted) {
    2878 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2879 ++shooting_count;
    2880 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2881 }
    2882 if (live_capture) {
    2883 if ((camera_mask & USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR) != 0) start_lwir_worker(shoot, request_id, monotonic_time_us());
    2884 camera_mask &= ~USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR;
    2885 }
    2886 if ((camera_mask & (USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK | USHER_CAMERA_MASK_AICAM | USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR)) == 0) {
    2887 if (chdk_admitted) send_msg_status();
    2888 return;
    2889 }
    2890 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    2891 if (!usher_running()) {
    2892 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2893 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, camera_mask);
    2894 queue_image_results(request_id, shoot->data.nr, camera_mask, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2895 return;
    2896 }
    2897 if (live_capture && waiting_capture != NULL && !waiting_capture->arbiter_owned) {
    2898 /* Replace the whole request, not just its number: old pose with a new image
    2899 * would be harder to detect than an explicitly superseded trigger. */
    2900 const union dc_shot_union replaced = waiting_capture->shot;
    2901 const uint32_t replaced_id = waiting_capture->request_id;
    2902 const uint8_t replaced_mask = waiting_capture->camera_mask;
    2903 waiting_capture->shot = *shoot;
    2904 waiting_capture->request_id = request_id;
    2905 waiting_capture->camera_mask = camera_mask;
    2906 waiting_capture->received_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2907 waiting_capture->shot_counted = chdk_admitted;
    2908 ++superseded_capture_count;
    2909 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2910 queue_image_results(replaced_id, replaced.data.nr, replaced_mask, USHER_SHOT_SUPERSEDED);
    2911 return;
    2912 }
    2913 if (shooting_thread_count >= MAX_PROCESSING_THREADS) {
    2914 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2915 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tprocessing queue is full\n", shoot->data.nr);
    2916 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, camera_mask);
    2917 queue_image_results(request_id, shoot->data.nr, camera_mask, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2918 return;
    2919 }
    2920 struct capture_job *job = capture_job_acquire_locked();
    2921 if (job == NULL) {
    2922 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2923 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tcapture job pool is full\n", shoot->data.nr);
    2924 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, camera_mask);
    2925 queue_image_results(request_id, shoot->data.nr, camera_mask, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2926 return;
    2927 }
    2928 job->shot = *shoot;
    2929 job->request_id = request_id;
    2930 job->camera_mask = camera_mask;
    2931 job->received_us = monotonic_time_us();
    2932 job->arbiter_owned = capture_arbiter_owns(shoot->data.nr);
    2933 job->shot_counted = chdk_admitted;
    2934 shooting_thread_count++;
    2935 job->ticket = next_job_ticket;
    2936
    2937 pthread_t shooting_thread;
    2938 int thread_result = pthread_create(&shooting_thread, NULL, handle_msg_shoot, job);
    2939 if (thread_result != 0) {
    2940 shooting_thread_count--;
    2941 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2942 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to start shooting thread: %s\n",
    2943 shoot->data.nr, strerror(thread_result));
    2944 capture_job_release(job);
    2945 capture_arbiter_failed(shoot, camera_mask);
    2946 queue_image_results(request_id, shoot->data.nr, camera_mask, USHER_SHOT_FAILED);
    2947 return;
    2948 }
    2949 ++next_job_ticket;
    2950 if (live_capture) waiting_capture = job;
    2951 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    2952 pthread_detach(shooting_thread);
    2953 send_msg_status();
    2954}
    2955
    2956/** @brief Release per-camera survey admission on a failure before normal completion.
    2957 * @param shoot Original request identifying active entries.
    2958 * @param mask Only the camera bits that failed; other sensors may still succeed.
    2959 */
    2960static void capture_arbiter_failed(const union dc_shot_union *shoot, uint8_t mask)
    2961{
    2962 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= COVERAGE_CAMERAS; ++camera_id)
    2963 if (mask & (1U << (camera_id - 1))) capture_arbiter_complete(shoot, camera_id, false, false, 0, monotonic_time_us());
    2964}
    2965
    2966/** @brief Reserve a zeroed slot in the bounded job pool.
    2967 * @return Slot owned by the caller, or NULL if the pool is full.
    2968 * @details The caller holds @c mut. A static pool makes overload explicit
    2969 * rather than allocating more jobs as capture latency grows. */
    2970static struct capture_job *capture_job_acquire_locked(void)
    2971{
    2972 for (size_t index = 0; index < CAPTURE_JOB_CAPACITY; ++index) {
    2973 if (capture_job_used[index]) continue;
    2974 capture_job_used[index] = true;
    2975 capture_jobs[index] = (struct capture_job) {0};
    2976 return &capture_jobs[index];
    2977 }
    2978 return NULL;
    2979}
    2980
    2981/** @brief Return a job slot while the caller owns the pool mutex.
    2982 * @param job Previously reserved slot; non-pool pointers are ignored.
    2983 * @details Clear the job before marking the slot available so the next
    2984 * owner cannot inherit request or camera state. */
    2985static void capture_job_release_locked(struct capture_job *job)
    2986{
    2987 for (size_t index = 0; index < CAPTURE_JOB_CAPACITY; ++index) {
    2988 if (job != &capture_jobs[index]) continue;
    2989 capture_jobs[index] = (struct capture_job) {0};
    2990 capture_job_used[index] = false;
    2991 return;
    2992 }
    2993}
    2994
    2995/** @brief Return a job slot from a worker that does not hold the pool lock.
    2996 * @param job Previously reserved slot, no longer in use by the caller.
    2997 * @details Take @c mut around pool bookkeeping; callers already holding
    2998 * it must use capture_job_release_locked() instead. */
    2999static void capture_job_release(struct capture_job *job)
    3000{
    3001 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3002 capture_job_release_locked(job);
    3003 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3004}
    3005
    3006/** @brief Bridge survey decisions to current backend readiness from the serial event loop.
    3007 * @param now_us Current MORA monotonic time in microseconds.
    3008 * @details Readiness is a snapshot, not a reservation. Dispatch still checks driver
    3009 * admission. Retain one popped result across a full UART TX queue rather than
    3010 * discarding it merely because the wire was briefly busy.
    3011 */
    3012static void service_capture_arbiter(uint64_t now_us)
    3013{
    3014 const uint32_t session = capture_arbiter_session_id();
    3015 if (!session) return;
    3016 static uint64_t hello_us;
    3017 if (!hello_us || now_us < hello_us || now_us - hello_us >= 500000) {
    3018 union usher_capture_arbiter_hello_union hello = {.data = {USHER_CAPTURE_ARBITER_VERSION, session}};
    3019 if (serial_tx_send(USHER_CAPTURE_ARBITER_HELLO, hello.bin, sizeof(hello.bin)) == 0) hello_us = now_us;
    3020 }
    3021 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3022 uint32_t ready = !is_shooting && !waiting_capture && shooting_thread_count < MAX_PROCESSING_THREADS
    3023 ? USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK | USHER_CAMERA_MASK_AICAM : 0;
    3024 if (chdk_async_capture_enabled && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only && !mock_map_enabled) {
    3025 ready &= ~USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK;
    3026 if (!chdk_capture_in_progress && now_us && now_us >= chdk_retry_after_us) ready |= USHER_CAMERA_MASK_CHDK;
    3027 }
    3028 if (!lwir_capture_in_progress && !lwir_recovery_in_progress) ready |= USHER_CAMERA_MASK_LWIR;
    3029 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3030 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= COVERAGE_CAMERAS; ++camera_id) {
    3031 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_backend_get(camera_type_for_id(camera_id));
    3032 const struct camera_capture_ops *ops = test_capture_enabled ? NULL : backend.capture_ops;
    3033 /* Live CHDK publishes one image while the next is captured. */
    3034 const bool chdk_pipelined = camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_CHDK && chdk_async_capture_enabled
    3035 && !test_capture_enabled && !local_capture_only && !mock_map_enabled;
    3036 const unsigned limit = ops ? ops->max_in_flight : chdk_pipelined ? 2 : 1;
    3037 if (!capture_arbiter_set_camera_capacity(camera_id, limit)
    3038 || (ops && ops->has_capacity && !ops->has_capacity())) ready &= ~(1U << (camera_id - 1));
    3039 }
    3040 static union usher_capture_arbiter_result_union result;
    3041 static bool result_pending;
    3042 if (!result_pending) result_pending = capture_arbiter_result(&result, ready);
    3043 if (result_pending
    3044 && serial_tx_send(USHER_CAPTURE_ARBITER_RESULT, result.bin, sizeof(result.bin)) == 0) result_pending = false;
    3045 union dc_shot_union shot;
    3046 uint8_t mask;
    3047 if (usher_running() && capture_arbiter_take(ready, now_us, &shot, &mask)) start_shoot_worker(&shot, mask, 0);
    3048 if (!usher_running()) capture_arbiter_stop();
    3049}
    3050
    3051/** @brief Collect stream updates and completed point-session results.
    3052 * @details Bound the work per backend to preserve UART service latency.
    3053 * Stream updates and stopped-session results use separate caches; reject
    3054 * session completions not matching the current stopped session. */
    3055static void service_camera_backends(void)
    3056{
    3057 backend_service_pending = false;
    3058 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++camera_id) {
    3059 const struct camera_point_stream_ops *stream = camera_owners[camera_id].point_stream;
    3060 if (stream && stream->poll_result
    3061 && (camera_stream_states[camera_id] == CAMERA_STREAM_ACTIVE
    3062 || camera_stream_states[camera_id] == CAMERA_STREAM_DRAINED)) {
    3063 struct camera_point_result update;
    3064 unsigned received = 0;
    3065 for (; received < MAX_BACKEND_RESULTS_PER_PASS && stream->poll_result(&update); ++received)
    3066 send_msg_cam_point_update(camera_id, &update);
    3067 if (received == MAX_BACKEND_RESULTS_PER_PASS) backend_service_pending = true;
    3068 }
    3069 const struct camera_session_ops *ops = camera_owners[camera_id].session;
    3070 if (!ops || !ops->poll_result) continue;
    3071 struct camera_point_result point;
    3072 unsigned received = 0;
    3073 for (; received < MAX_BACKEND_RESULTS_PER_PASS && ops->poll_result(&point); ++received) {
    3074 if (point.session_id && point_sessions[camera_id - 1].id == point.session_id
    3075 && point_sessions[camera_id - 1].stop_requested
    3076 && point_sessions[camera_id - 1].result.data.session_id != point.session_id)
    3077 send_msg_cam_point(camera_id, point.session_id, &point);
    3078 }
    3079 if (received == MAX_BACKEND_RESULTS_PER_PASS) backend_service_pending = true;
    3080 }
    3081}
    3082
    3083/** @brief Ask active streams and sessions to drain, then service remaining results.
    3084 * @details Mark streams drained before invoking callbacks. The service pass
    3085 * still permits already-available results from drained streams. */
    3086static void drain_camera_backends(void)
    3087{
    3088 for (unsigned camera_id = 1; camera_id <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++camera_id) {
    3089 const struct camera_point_stream_ops *stream = camera_owners[camera_id].point_stream;
    3090 if (stream && camera_stream_states[camera_id] == CAMERA_STREAM_ACTIVE) {
    3091 camera_stream_states[camera_id] = CAMERA_STREAM_DRAINED;
    3092 if (stream->drain) stream->drain();
    3093 }
    3094 const struct camera_session_ops *ops = camera_owners[camera_id].session;
    3095 if (ops && ops->drain) ops->drain();
    3096 }
    3097 service_camera_backends();
    3098}
    3099
    3100/** @brief Start a point session for the addressed backend or backends.
    3101 * @param camera_id Camera ID, or USHER_CAMERA_ALL for broadcast.
    3102 * @param session_id Nonzero session identifier from the caller.
    3103 * @details Treat a duplicate START as idempotent and clear old result state
    3104 * only for a new ID. Prefer the configured point stream when present. */
    3105static void handle_targeted_start(uint32_t camera_id, uint32_t session_id)
    3106{
    3107 if (camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID || !session_id) return;
    3108 service_camera_backends();
    3109 printf("USHER:\tSTART cam %u session %u\n", camera_id, session_id);
    3110 for (size_t slot = 0; slot < CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++slot) {
    3111 if (camera_id != USHER_CAMERA_ALL && slot != camera_id - 1) continue;
    3112 if (point_sessions[slot].id == session_id) continue;
    3113 point_sessions[slot].id = session_id;
    3114 point_sessions[slot].result = (union usher_cam_point_result_union) {0};
    3115 point_sessions[slot].pending = false;
    3116 point_sessions[slot].stop_requested = false;
    3117 if (!camera_owners[slot + 1].point_stream) {
    3118 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_backend_get(camera_type_for_id(slot + 1));
    3119 if (backend.point_stream) camera_register_stream(&backend);
    3120 }
    3121 const struct camera_point_stream_ops *stream = camera_owners[slot + 1].point_stream;
    3122 if (stream) {
    3123 if (camera_stream_states[slot + 1] == CAMERA_STREAM_ACTIVE && stream->start
    3124 && (!stream->enabled || stream->enabled()) && !stream->start(session_id))
    3125 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tphoto point stream not enabled\n");
    3126 continue;
    3127 }
    3128 if (prepare_session_backend(slot + 1) && !camera_owners[slot + 1].session->start(session_id))
    3129 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\t%s session %u unavailable/full; stopped evidence retained\n",
    3130 camera_owners[slot + 1].name, session_id);
    3131 }
    3132}
    3133
    3134/** @brief Request the stop phase for a matching point session.
    3135 * @param camera_id Camera ID, or USHER_CAMERA_ALL for broadcast.
    3136 * @param session_id Nonzero session identifier.
    3137 * @details Ignore a stale session. For a repeated STOP, resend a cached
    3138 * result when available instead of rerunning the stop transition. */
    3139static void handle_targeted_stop(uint32_t camera_id, uint32_t session_id)
    3140{
    3141 if (camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID || !session_id) return;
    3142 if (camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_ALL) {
    3143 for (uint32_t selected = 1; selected <= CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++selected) handle_targeted_stop(selected, session_id);
    3144 return;
    3145 }
    3146 const size_t slot = camera_id - 1;
    3147 if (point_sessions[slot].id != session_id) return;
    3148 if (point_sessions[slot].result.data.session_id == session_id) {
    3149 point_sessions[slot].pending = true;
    3150 flush_cam_points();
    3151 return;
    3152 }
    3153 if (point_sessions[slot].stop_requested) return;
    3154 point_sessions[slot].stop_requested = true;
    3155 printf("USHER:\tSTOP cam %u session %u\n", camera_id, session_id);
    3156 const struct camera_point_stream_ops *stream = camera_owners[camera_id].point_stream;
    3157 if (stream) {
    3158 if (camera_stream_states[camera_id] == CAMERA_STREAM_ACTIVE && stream->stop
    3159 && (!stream->enabled || stream->enabled()) && !stream->stop(session_id))
    3160 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tphoto point return phase unavailable\n");
    3161 return;
    3162 }
    3163 const struct camera_session_ops *ops = camera_owners[camera_id].session;
    3164 if (!ops || !ops->stop || !ops->stop(session_id)) send_msg_cam_point(camera_id, session_id, NULL);
    3165}
    3166
    3167/** @brief Check whether a backend result is suitable for the point wire format.
    3168 * @param point Nullable candidate point.
    3169 * @return True when marked valid and within the coordinate, height, and quality bounds.
    3170 * @details Reject the all-zero geographic placeholder; passing this check
    3171 * does not establish survey accuracy. */
    3172static bool camera_point_valid(const struct camera_point_result *point)
    3173{
    3174 return point && point->valid && point->lat >= -900000000 && point->lat <= 900000000
    3175 && point->lon >= -1800000000 && point->lon <= 1800000000
    3176 && (point->lat != 0 || point->lon != 0) && point->agl_mm >= 0
    3177 && point->quality >= 0 && point->quality <= 1000;
    3178}
    3179
    3180/** @brief Cache and attempt to queue a terminal point-session result.
    3181 * @param camera_id Concrete backend ID.
    3182 * @param session_id Nonzero identifier for the session being completed.
    3183 * @param point Backend result, or NULL for no valid point.
    3184 * @details Keep the result after successful transmission so a repeated STOP
    3185 * can recover it. Invalid points carry status but no coordinates. */
    3186static void send_msg_cam_point(uint32_t camera_id, uint32_t session_id, const struct camera_point_result *point)
    3187{
    3188 if (camera_id < 1 || camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID || !session_id) return;
    3189 union usher_cam_point_result_union result;
    3190 memset(&result, 0, sizeof(result));
    3191 result.data.camera_id = camera_id;
    3192 result.data.session_id = session_id;
    3193 const bool valid = camera_point_valid(point);
    3194 result.data.status = valid ? USHER_CAM_POINT_VALID : USHER_CAM_POINT_INVALID;
    3195 if (point && valid) {
    3196 result.data.lat = point->lat;
    3197 result.data.lon = point->lon;
    3198 result.data.agl_mm = point->agl_mm;
    3199 result.data.alt_mm = point->alt_mm;
    3200 result.data.metric = point->metric;
    3201 result.data.quality = point->quality;
    3202 }
    3203
    3204 point_sessions[camera_id - 1].result = result;
    3205 point_sessions[camera_id - 1].pending = true;
    3206 flush_cam_points();
    3207}
    3208
    3209/** @brief Keep only the newest stream result per camera across UART backpressure. */
    3210static void send_msg_cam_point_update(uint32_t camera_id, const struct camera_point_result *point)
    3211{
    3212 if (!point || !point->session_id || camera_id < 1 || camera_id > CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID) return;
    3213 union usher_cam_point_update_union update = {.data = {
    3214 .camera_id = camera_id, .frame_number = point->session_id,
    3215 .status = camera_point_valid(point) ? USHER_CAM_POINT_VALID : USHER_CAM_POINT_INVALID
    3216 }
    3217 };
    3218 if (update.data.status == USHER_CAM_POINT_VALID) {
    3219 update.data.lat = point->lat; update.data.lon = point->lon;
    3220 update.data.alt_mm = point->alt_mm; update.data.agl_mm = point->agl_mm;
    3221 update.data.quality = point->quality; update.data.metric = point->metric;
    3222 }
    3223 point_updates[camera_id - 1] = update;
    3224 point_update_pending[camera_id - 1] = true;
    3225}
    3226
    3227/** @brief Publish fresh stream mailboxes without changing stopped-session result caches. */
    3228static void flush_cam_point_updates(void)
    3229{
    3230 for (size_t slot = 0; slot < CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++slot) {
    3231 if (!point_update_pending[slot]) continue;
    3232 if (serial_tx_send(USHER_CAM_POINT_UPDATE, point_updates[slot].bin, sizeof(point_updates[slot].bin)) != 0) return;
    3233 point_update_pending[slot] = false;
    3234 }
    3235}
    3236
    3237/** @brief Submit unsent point-session results to the UART transmit queue.
    3238 * @details Clear only the pending flag on success. A full transmit queue
    3239 * leaves the receipt pending for the next event-loop pass. */
    3240static void flush_cam_points(void)
    3241{
    3242 for (size_t slot = 0; slot < CAMERA_BACKEND_MAX_ID; ++slot) {
    3243 if (!point_sessions[slot].pending) continue;
    3244 const union usher_cam_point_result_union *result = &point_sessions[slot].result;
    3245 if (serial_tx_send(USHER_CAM_POINT_RESULT, result->bin, sizeof(result->bin)) != 0) return;
    3246 point_sessions[slot].pending = false;
    3247 }
    3248}
    3249
    3250/** @brief Launch optional mapping as a separate process with no inherited UART descriptors.
    3251 * @details A map worker consumes saved originals, not capture slots. Failure to
    3252 * start it is reported but never grounds the photo pipeline.
    3253 */
    3254static void start_pangea(void)
    3255{
    3256 char executable[PATH_MAX], photos[PATH_MAX], map_dir[PATH_MAX], pause_path[PATH_MAX], parent[32], since[32];
    3257 ssize_t length = readlink("/proc/self/exe", executable, sizeof(executable) - 1);
    3258 if (length <= 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(executable) - 1) {
    3259 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tPANGEA path unavailable; capture continues\n");
    3260 return;
    3261 }
    3262 executable[length] = '\0';
    3263 char *base = strrchr(executable, '/');
    3264 if (base == NULL || (size_t)(base - executable) + sizeof("/bin/pangea") > sizeof(executable)) return;
    3265 snprintf(base, sizeof(executable) - (size_t)(base - executable), "/bin/pangea");
    3266 const char *photo_root = USHER_LOCAL_PHOTO_DIR;
    3267 if (pangea_camera_profile != NULL) {
    3268 if (!camera.photo_directory) return;
    3269 photo_root = camera.photo_directory;
    3270 }
    3271 const char *photo_directory = usher_resolve_path(photo_root, photos, sizeof(photos));
    3272 const char *output_directory = usher_resolve_path(pangea_directory, map_dir, sizeof(map_dir));
    3273 if (photo_directory == NULL || output_directory == NULL || output_directory[0] == '\0') return;
    3274 snprintf(parent, sizeof(parent), "%ld", (long)getpid());
    3275 snprintf(since, sizeof(since), "%lld", (long long)time(NULL));
    3276 char *arguments[15] = {executable, "--input", (char *)photo_directory, "--output", (char *)output_directory,
    3277 "--watch", "--parent-pid", parent, "--since", since
    3278 };
    3279 size_t argument_count = 10;
    3280 if (pangea_camera_profile != NULL) {
    3281 arguments[argument_count++] = "--camera-profile";
    3282 arguments[argument_count++] = (char *)pangea_camera_profile;
    3283 }
    3284 if (pangea_pause_file != NULL) {
    3285 const char *resolved_pause = usher_resolve_path(pangea_pause_file, pause_path, sizeof(pause_path));
    3286 if (resolved_pause == NULL || resolved_pause[0] == '\0') return;
    3287 arguments[argument_count++] = "--pause-file";
    3288 arguments[argument_count++] = (char *)resolved_pause;
    3289 }
    3290 arguments[argument_count] = NULL;
    3291 int result = posix_spawn(&pangea_pid, executable, NULL, NULL, arguments, environ);
    3292 if (result != 0) {
    3293 pangea_pid = -1;
    3294 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tPANGEA unavailable: %s; capture continues\n", strerror(result));
    3295 } else {
    3296 printf("USHER:\tPANGEA background watcher pid %ld, map directory %s\n", (long)pangea_pid, output_directory);
    3297 }
    3298}
    3299
    3300/** @brief Poll an owned subprocess for exit.
    3301 * @param[in,out] child Positive child PID, reset to -1 when ownership ends.
    3302 * @param timeout_ms Polling budget in milliseconds.
    3303 * @return True if reaped or no longer a child; false on deadline or wait error.
    3304 * @details Retain the PID on failure so later cleanup still knows which
    3305 * child it owns. */
    3306static bool wait_owned_child(pid_t *child, unsigned timeout_ms)
    3307{
    3308 const uint64_t started_us = monotonic_time_us();
    3309 for (;;) {
    3310 int status = 0;
    3311 const pid_t result = waitpid(*child, &status, WNOHANG);
    3312 if (result == *child || (result < 0 && errno == ECHILD)) { *child = -1; return true; }
    3313 if (result < 0 && errno != EINTR) return false;
    3314 const uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    3315 if (!started_us || !now_us || now_us < started_us
    3316 || now_us - started_us >= (uint64_t)timeout_ms * 1000) return false;
    3317 if (poll(NULL, 0, 10) < 0 && errno != EINTR) return false;
    3318 }
    3319}
    3320
    3321/** @brief Bound optional map-worker shutdown rather than waiting for its input backlog. */
    3322static void stop_pangea(void)
    3323{
    3324 if (pangea_pid <= 0 || wait_owned_child(&pangea_pid, 0)) return;
    3325 kill(pangea_pid, SIGTERM);
    3326 if (wait_owned_child(&pangea_pid, 100)) return;
    3327 kill(pangea_pid, SIGKILL);
    3328 if (!wait_owned_child(&pangea_pid, 1500))
    3329 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tPANGEA has not exited after SIGKILL; retaining child ownership\n");
    3330}
    3331
    3332/** @brief Run saved-file analysis with fresh priority and idle catch-up.
    3333 * @param unused Unused pthread argument.
    3334 * @return NULL when stopped; pending filenames remain on disk, not in a durable job queue.
    3335 * @details One lower-priority worker limits concurrent decoding. It never owns a
    3336 * camera slot. An already running analysis is not preempted when a trigger arrives.
    3337 */
    3338static void *handle_soda_backlog(void *unused)
    3339{
    3340 (void)unused;
    3341 if (setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, 0, 10) != 0) {
    3342 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tcannot lower SODA backlog priority: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    3343 }
    3344 for (;;) {
    3345 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3346 while (soda_backlog_count == 0 && !soda_backlog_stop && usher_running()) {
    3347 pthread_cond_wait(&soda_available, &mut);
    3348 }
    3349 if (soda_backlog_stop || !usher_running()) {
    3350 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3351 return NULL;
    3352 }
    3353 uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    3354 size_t selected = (soda_backlog_head + soda_backlog_count - 1) % SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY;
    3355 bool fresh = soda_backlog[selected].attempts == 0 && now_us != 0
    3356 && now_us >= soda_backlog[selected].queued_us
    3357 && now_us - soda_backlog[selected].queued_us < (uint64_t)USHER_SODA_IDLE_MS * 1000;
    3358 bool quiet = now_us != 0 && now_us >= last_photo_request_us
    3359 && now_us - last_photo_request_us >= (uint64_t)USHER_SODA_IDLE_MS * 1000;
    3360 if (!fresh && quiet) {
    3361 /* A retry in cooldown must not block other ready originals. Rotate at
    3362 * most the current queue length, preserving bounded work even if all wait. */
    3363 for (size_t scanned = 0; scanned < soda_backlog_count; ++scanned) {
    3364 if (soda_backlog[soda_backlog_head].retry_after_us <= now_us) break;
    3365 size_t tail = (soda_backlog_head + soda_backlog_count) % SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY;
    3366 soda_backlog[tail] = soda_backlog[soda_backlog_head];
    3367 soda_backlog_head = (soda_backlog_head + 1) % SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY;
    3368 }
    3369 selected = soda_backlog_head;
    3370 }
    3371 if ((!fresh && (!quiet || shooting_thread_count != 0 || lwir_capture_in_progress))
    3372 || soda_backlog[selected].retry_after_us > now_us
    3373 || pthread_mutex_trylock(&live_soda_mutex) != 0) {
    3374 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3375 poll(NULL, 0, 50);
    3376 continue;
    3377 }
    3378 struct soda_job job = soda_backlog[selected];
    3379 if (!fresh) soda_backlog_head = (soda_backlog_head + 1) % SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY;
    3380 --soda_backlog_count;
    3381 soda_backlog_active = true;
    3382 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3383
    3384 /* Stat identity catches ordinary replacement between enqueue and replay.
    3385 * Do not apply old pose to a new file with a familiar name; this is not a
    3386 * security boundary against concurrent hostile file modification. */
    3387 struct stat source;
    3388 bool same_source = lstat(job.filename, &source) == 0 && S_ISREG(source.st_mode)
    3389 && source.st_dev == job.source.st_dev && source.st_ino == job.source.st_ino
    3390 && source.st_size == job.source.st_size
    3391 && source.st_mtim.tv_sec == job.source.st_mtim.tv_sec
    3392 && source.st_mtim.tv_nsec == job.source.st_mtim.tv_nsec;
    3393 uint64_t analysis_started_us = monotonic_time_us();
    3394 if (same_source && !job.spotting_done && job.camera_id == USHER_CAMERA_LWIRCAM && lwir_spotter_enabled()) {
    3395 const int spotting = lwir_spotter_analyze(job.filename, &job.shot, &job.timing, &keep_running);
    3396 job.spotting_done = true;
    3397 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tLWIR spotting %s; original and capture timing retained\n",
    3398 job.shot.data.nr, spotting == 0 ? "complete" : "failed");
    3399 same_source = lstat(job.filename, &source) == 0 && S_ISREG(source.st_mode)
    3400 && source.st_dev == job.source.st_dev && source.st_ino == job.source.st_ino
    3401 && source.st_size == job.source.st_size && source.st_mtim.tv_sec == job.source.st_mtim.tv_sec
    3402 && source.st_mtim.tv_nsec == job.source.st_mtim.tv_nsec;
    3403 }
    3404 int result = same_source ? run_soda(job.filename, &job.shot, job.camera_id) : -1;
    3405 if (debug_enabled) {
    3406 printf("USHER-%d TIMING:\tcamera=%d soda_ms=%.3f mode=%s result=%d\n",
    3407 job.shot.data.nr, job.camera_id,
    3408 (monotonic_time_us() - analysis_started_us) / 1000.0,
    3409 fresh ? "fresh" : "idle", result);
    3410 }
    3411 if (!same_source) {
    3412 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tSODA backlog source missing/changed; old pose not applied: %s\n",
    3413 job.shot.data.nr, job.filename);
    3414 }
    3415 pthread_mutex_unlock(&live_soda_mutex);
    3416 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3417 /* One retry allows transient output failures without a poisoned image
    3418 * monopolizing the worker. Partial CSV/crop side effects are not exactly-once. */
    3419 if (result != 0 && same_source && ++job.attempts < 2 && usher_running()
    3420 && !soda_backlog_stop && soda_backlog_count < SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY) {
    3421 job.retry_after_us = monotonic_time_us() + (uint64_t)USHER_SODA_RETRY_MS * 1000;
    3422 size_t tail = (soda_backlog_head + soda_backlog_count) % SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY;
    3423 soda_backlog[tail] = job;
    3424 ++soda_backlog_count;
    3425 } else if (result == 0) ++soda_backlog_completed;
    3426 else ++soda_backlog_failed;
    3427 soda_backlog_active = false;
    3428 size_t pending = soda_backlog_count;
    3429 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    3430 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3431 printf("USHER-%d:\tSODA backlog mode=%s result=%d pending=%zu, original retained: %s\n",
    3432 job.shot.data.nr, fresh ? "fresh" : "idle", result, pending, job.filename);
    3433 }
    3434}
    3435
    3436/** @brief Queue analysis of a saved original without retaining camera or pixel buffers.
    3437 * @param filename Nonempty regular image file, unchanged while queued.
    3438 * @param shoot Pose/number associated with that saved image, copied into the job.
    3439 * @param camera_id Sensor-specific SODA route.
    3440 * @details Overflow keeps existing queued work and leaves the new original on disk.
    3441 * Worker-creation failure retains the job so a later submission can retry startup.
    3442 */
    3443static void defer_soda(const char *filename, const union dc_shot_union *shoot, int camera_id)
    3444{
    3445 defer_saved_analysis(filename, shoot, camera_id, NULL);
    3446}
    3447
    3448/** @brief Submit a published image to the bounded saved-analysis backlog.
    3449 * @param filename Path of the nonempty original JPEG.
    3450 * @param shoot Trigger evidence copied into the job.
    3451 * @param camera_id Camera identity used to route the analysis.
    3452 * @param timing Optional capture timing copied into the job.
    3453 * @details Save file identity with the job so the worker can detect a
    3454 * later replacement. If the backlog is unavailable, preserve the original
    3455 * for offline processing rather than blocking capture. */
    3456static void defer_saved_analysis(const char *filename, const union dc_shot_union *shoot, int camera_id,
    3457 const struct capture_timing *timing)
    3458{
    3459 if (!filename || !filename[0] || !shoot) return;
    3460 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_identity_get(camera_id);
    3461 if (!backend.name || !backend.soda_application || !backend.soda_option) return;
    3462 size_t length = strnlen(filename, MAX_FILENAME);
    3463 struct stat source;
    3464 bool source_valid = lstat(filename, &source) == 0 && S_ISREG(source.st_mode) && source.st_size > 0;
    3465 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3466 if (soda_backlog_stop || !usher_running() || !source_valid || length >= MAX_FILENAME
    3467 || soda_backlog_count == SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY) {
    3468 ++soda_backlog_overflow;
    3469 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3470 fprintf(stderr,
    3471 "USHER-%d:\tSODA backlog unavailable/full; original and flight EXIF retained for offline analysis: %s\n",
    3472 shoot->data.nr, filename);
    3473 return;
    3474 }
    3475 size_t tail = (soda_backlog_head + soda_backlog_count) % SODA_BACKLOG_CAPACITY;
    3476 struct soda_job *job = &soda_backlog[tail];
    3477 for (size_t index = 0; index <= length; ++index) job->filename[index] = filename[index];
    3478 job->shot = *shoot;
    3479 job->timing = timing ? *timing : (struct capture_timing) {0};
    3480 job->spotting_done = false;
    3481 job->camera_id = camera_id;
    3482 job->source = source;
    3483 job->queued_us = monotonic_time_us();
    3484 job->retry_after_us = 0;
    3485 job->attempts = 0;
    3486 bool busy = soda_backlog_active || soda_backlog_count != 0;
    3487 if (busy) ++soda_busy_deferred_count;
    3488 size_t pending = ++soda_backlog_count;
    3489 if (!soda_backlog_started) {
    3490 int result = pthread_create(&soda_backlog_thread, NULL, handle_soda_backlog, NULL);
    3491 soda_backlog_started = result == 0;
    3492 if (result != 0) {
    3493 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tSODA backlog worker unavailable: %s; photos continue\n", strerror(result));
    3494 }
    3495 }
    3496 pthread_cond_signal(&soda_available);
    3497 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3498 printf("USHER-%d:\tSODA %s pending=%zu: %s\n",
    3499 shoot->data.nr, busy ? "deferred" : "submitted", pending, filename);
    3500}
    3501
    3502/** @brief Join the analysis worker without draining session-only pending jobs.
    3503 * @pre Set keep_running to zero first so an active run_soda() follows its shutdown deadline.
    3504 * @details Joining ensures analysis no longer touches state that camera cleanup
    3505 * may release. Originals survive; pending analysis is not automatically persisted.
    3506 */
    3507static void stop_soda_backlog(void)
    3508{
    3509 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3510 soda_backlog_stop = true;
    3511 pthread_cond_broadcast(&soda_available);
    3512 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3513 if (soda_backlog_started) pthread_join(soda_backlog_thread, NULL);
    3514 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3515 soda_backlog_started = false;
    3516 fprintf(stderr, "USHER SODA:\tcompleted=%" PRIu64 " failed=%" PRIu64
    3517 " pending=%zu unavailable/full=%" PRIu64 "; original photos retained\n",
    3518 soda_backlog_completed, soda_backlog_failed, soda_backlog_count, soda_backlog_overflow);
    3519 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3520}
    3521
    3522/** @brief Run one analysis child directly with bounded runtime and termination grace.
    3523 * @param filename Saved original to analyze, never deleted by this function.
    3524 * @param shoot Immutable image-associated pose used to form arguments.
    3525 * @param camera_id Sensor route selecting the SODA option.
    3526 * @return Child exit status, or -1 for spawn/wait/cancellation/deadline failure.
    3527 * @note Direct argv avoids shell interpretation. Successful exit means processing
    3528 * completed, not that an object was detected or that each side effect is unique.
    3529 */
    3530static int run_soda(const char *filename, const union dc_shot_union *shoot, int camera_id)
    3531{
    3532 if (!filename || !filename[0] || !shoot) return -1;
    3533 const struct camera_backend backend = camera_identity_get(camera_id);
    3534 if (!backend.name) {
    3535 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tinvalid SODA camera id %d\n", camera_id);
    3536 return -1;
    3537 }
    3538 const char *soda_application = test_capture_enabled || local_capture_only ? USHER_SODA : backend.soda_application;
    3539 const char *camera_option = backend.soda_option;
    3540 if (!soda_application || !soda_application[0] || !camera_option) return -1;
    3541 char values[10][16];
    3542 const int32_t fields[10] = {
    3543 shoot->data.nr, shoot->data.lat, shoot->data.lon, shoot->data.alt,
    3544 shoot->data.phi, shoot->data.theta, shoot->data.psi, shoot->data.vground,
    3545 shoot->data.course, shoot->data.groundalt
    3546 };
    3547 for (size_t index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
    3548 int length = snprintf(values[index], sizeof(values[index]), "%d", fields[index]);
    3549 if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(values[index])) {
    3550 return -1;
    3551 }
    3552 }
    3553
    3554 char *arguments[19] = {
    3555 (char *)soda_application, (char *)filename,
    3556 values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4],
    3557 values[5], values[6], values[7], values[8], values[9], NULL, NULL, NULL
    3558 };
    3559 size_t argument_count = 12;
    3560 if (camera_option != NULL) arguments[argument_count++] = (char *)camera_option;
    3561 if (local_mode) arguments[argument_count++] = (char *)"--local";
    3562 arguments[argument_count] = NULL;
    3563 if (debug_enabled) {
    3564 printf("USHER-%d DEBUG:\tstarting SODA directly: %s\n",
    3565 shoot->data.nr, soda_application);
    3566 }
    3567
    3568 pid_t soda_pid;
    3569 posix_spawnattr_t attributes;
    3570 int spawn_result = posix_spawnattr_init(&attributes);
    3571 if (spawn_result) return -1;
    3572 sigset_t mask, defaults;
    3573 sigemptyset(&mask);
    3574 sigemptyset(&defaults);
    3575 sigaddset(&defaults, SIGINT);
    3576 sigaddset(&defaults, SIGTERM);
    3577 spawn_result = posix_spawnattr_setsigmask(&attributes, &mask);
    3578 if (!spawn_result) spawn_result = posix_spawnattr_setsigdefault(&attributes, &defaults);
    3579 if (!spawn_result) spawn_result = posix_spawnattr_setpgroup(&attributes, 0);
    3580 if (!spawn_result) spawn_result = posix_spawnattr_setflags(&attributes,
    3581 POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGMASK | POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGDEF | POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP);
    3582 if (!spawn_result) spawn_result = posix_spawnp(&soda_pid, soda_application, NULL, &attributes,
    3583 arguments, environ);
    3584 posix_spawnattr_destroy(&attributes);
    3585 if (spawn_result != 0) {
    3586 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tfailed to start SODA: %s\n",
    3587 shoot->data.nr, strerror(spawn_result));
    3588 return -1;
    3589 }
    3590
    3591 int status = 0;
    3592 const uint64_t started_us = monotonic_time_us();
    3593 uint64_t termination_us = 0;
    3594 bool terminating = false;
    3595 for (;;) {
    3596 pid_t wait_result = waitpid(soda_pid, &status, WNOHANG);
    3597 if (wait_result == soda_pid) {
    3598 break;
    3599 }
    3600 if (wait_result < 0 && errno != EINTR) {
    3601 return -1;
    3602 }
    3603 const uint64_t now_us = monotonic_time_us();
    3604 if (!terminating && (!usher_running() || now_us == 0 || started_us == 0
    3605 || now_us - started_us >= (uint64_t)USHER_SODA_TIMEOUT_MS * 1000)) {
    3606 fprintf(stderr, "USHER-%d:\tSODA %s; stopping analysis, original photo retained\n",
    3607 shoot->data.nr, usher_running() ? "runtime deadline reached" : "shutdown");
    3608 kill(-soda_pid, SIGTERM);
    3609 kill(soda_pid, SIGTERM);
    3610 termination_us = now_us;
    3611 terminating = true;
    3612 } else if (terminating && (now_us == 0
    3613 || now_us - termination_us >= (uint64_t)SODA_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS * 1000)) {
    3614 kill(-soda_pid, SIGKILL);
    3615 kill(soda_pid, SIGKILL);
    3616 }
    3617 sleep_microseconds(SODA_WAIT_INTERVAL_US);
    3618 }
    3619 return !terminating && WIFEXITED(status) ? WEXITSTATUS(status) : -1;
    3620}
    3621
    3622/** @brief End worker ownership after publication, distinct from releasing the capture ticket. */
    3623static void release_worker_slot(void)
    3624{
    3625 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3626 shooting_thread_count--;
    3627 wake_event_loop();
    3628 pthread_cond_broadcast(&workers_finished);
    3629 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3630}
    3631
    3632/** @brief Consume the newest buffered payload for a legacy image request.
    3633 * @details This compatibility path consumes the entry before queueing
    3634 * transmission; if queue admission fails, the entry is not retried. */
    3635static inline void send_msg_image_buffer(void)
    3636{
    3637 // Check if image is available
    3638 if (image_count > 0) {
    3639 printf("USHER:\thandle_msg_buffer: Send %d\n", image_idx);
    3640 // Send the image
    3641 image_idx = (MAX_IMAGE_BUFFERS + image_idx - 1) % MAX_IMAGE_BUFFERS;
    3642 image_count--;
    3643
    3644 if (serial_tx_send(USHER_PAYLOAD, (const uint8_t *)image_buffer[image_idx], IMAGE_SIZE) != 0) {
    3645 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\timage UART send failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    3646 }
    3647 }
    3648}
    3649
    3650/** @brief Queue a snapshot of USHER's capture counters.
    3651 * @details Copy shared counters under the mutex, then release it before
    3652 * UART admission so capture workers need not wait on the transport path. */
    3653static inline void send_msg_status(void)
    3654{
    3655 union usher_status_union status_msg = {0};
    3656
    3657 pthread_mutex_lock(&mut);
    3658 status_msg.data.cpu = 0;
    3659 status_msg.data.threads = shooting_thread_count + (chdk_capture_in_progress ? 1 : 0);
    3660 status_msg.data.shots = shooting_count;
    3661 status_msg.data.extra = 0;
    3662 pthread_mutex_unlock(&mut);
    3663
    3664 if (serial_tx_send(USHER_STATUS, status_msg.bin, sizeof(status_msg.bin)) != 0) {
    3665 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tstatus UART send failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    3666 }
    3667}
    3668
    3669/** @brief Print the invocation modes and build-specific defaults.
    3670 * @param program Executable spelling to use in examples.
    3671 * @details Report compiled endpoint values rather than assuming the same
    3672 * defaults for native and board builds. */
    3673static void print_usage(const char *program)
    3674{
    3675 puts(USHER_BUILD_VERSION);
    3676 printf("Usage: %s [--serial DEVICE | --local] [--chdk | --aicam | --spottercam | --lwircam | --loomcam] [--earcam] [--test] [OPTIONS]\n",
    3677 program);
    3678 printf(" %s (--chdk | --aicam | --spottercam | --lwircam) --speedtest\n", program);
    3679 printf(" --serial DEVICE serial endpoint (default: %s)\n", USHER_SERIAL_DEVICE);
    3680 printf(" --local create local serial bridge %s <-> %s\n",
    3681 USHER_LOCAL_SIM_DEVICE, USHER_LOCAL_APP_DEVICE);
    3682 printf(" --chdk use the CHDK camera backend\n");
    3683 printf(" --aicam use system-installed rpicam-still (plain capture, no detection)\n");

    3735/** @brief Return an immutable capability description without selecting or opening a camera.
    3736 * @param type Resolved runtime backend type.
    3737 * @return Descriptor with static hook lifetimes, or a zero descriptor for an invalid type.
    3738 */
    3739static struct camera_backend camera_backend_get(enum camera_backend_type type)
    3740{
    3741 struct camera_backend backend = camera_backend_registry_get(type, test_capture_enabled || mock_map_enabled);
    3742 if (type == CAMERA_BACKEND_LOCAL) backend.shoot = local_backend_shoot;
    3743 return backend;
    3744}
    3745
    3746/** @brief Resolve metadata and hooks for a concrete protocol camera identity.
    3747 * @param camera_id Protocol camera ID.
    3748 * @return Registry entry for the current routing mode.
    3749 * @details Keep identity lookup separate from selecting the global backend
    3750 * so a second sensor's result does not change capture configuration. */
    3751static struct camera_backend camera_identity_get(int camera_id)
    3752{
    3753 return camera_backend_registry_identity(camera_id, configured_camera_backend,
    3754 test_capture_enabled || mock_map_enabled);
    3755}
    3756
    3757/** @brief Install the startup backend, optionally with local test hooks.
    3758 * @param type Requested registry backend.
    3759 * @param test_mode True to replace hardware capture with simulation.
    3760 * @return Zero on selection, or -1 if the registry has no such backend.
    3761 * @details Preserve the selected camera identity in test mode while removing
    3762 * native capture operations so a mock job cannot acquire the hardware. */
    3763static int camera_backend_select(enum camera_backend_type type, bool test_mode)
    3764{
    3765 struct camera_backend selected = camera_backend_registry_get(type, test_mode || mock_map_enabled);
    3766 if (type == CAMERA_BACKEND_LOCAL) selected.shoot = local_backend_shoot;
    3767 if (!selected.name) {
    3768 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tinvalid camera backend\n");
    3769 return -1;
    3770 }
    3771 camera = selected;
    3772
    3773 if (test_mode) {
    3774 camera.init = mock_map_enabled ? local_pipe_map_init : local_pipe_test_init;
    3775 camera.shoot = local_backend_shoot;
    3776 camera.deinit = local_pipe_deinit;
    3777 camera.soda_application = USHER_SODA;
    3778 camera.capture_ops = NULL;
    3779 camera.capabilities |= CAMERA_CAP_MOCK;
    3780 }
    3781 return 0;
    3782}

    3784/** @brief Capture a local fixture under the selected optical camera identity.
    3785 * @param[out] filename Output path; use only on success.
    3786 * @param filename_size Capacity including the terminator.
    3787 * @param image_number Photo number.
    3788 * @return Zero on capture, or -1 on invalid identity or capture failure.
    3789 * @details Supply the concrete camera identity so the fixture uses the
    3790 * appropriate prefix while remaining distinct from a physical capture. */
    3791static int local_backend_shoot(char *filename, size_t filename_size, int image_number)
    3792{
    3793 const struct camera_backend identity = camera_identity_get(optical_camera_id);
    3794 if (optical_camera_id < USHER_CAMERA_CHDK || optical_camera_id > USHER_CAMERA_EARCAM) {
    3795 return -1;
    3796 }
    3797 return local_pipe_shoot(filename, filename_size, image_number, &identity);
    3798}

    3800/** @brief Reserve the shared local serial endpoint namespace.
    3801 * @return Zero on exclusive reservation, or -1 when it cannot be acquired.
    3802 * @details Keep the advisory lock descriptor open until teardown to stop
    3803 * another local instance from replacing the active endpoint links. */
    3804static int lock_local_instance(void)
    3805{
    3806 local_lock_fd = open(USHER_LOCAL_LOCK_FILE, O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
    3807 if (local_lock_fd < 0) {
    3808 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tfailed to open local instance lock %s: %s\n",
    3809 USHER_LOCAL_LOCK_FILE, strerror(errno));
    3810 return -1;
    3811 }
    3812 struct flock lock = {
    3813 .l_type = F_WRLCK,
    3814 .l_whence = SEEK_SET,
    3815 .l_start = 0,
    3816 .l_len = 0
    3817 };
    3818 if (fcntl(local_lock_fd, F_SETLK, &lock) != 0) {
    3819 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tlocal mode is already running; stop it before starting another instance\n");
    3820 close(local_lock_fd);
    3821 local_lock_fd = -1;
    3822 return -1;
    3823 }
    3824 return 0;
    3825}
    3826
    3827/** @brief Launch the PTY bridge for a hardware-free session.
    3828 * @return Owned child PID once both links appear, or -1 on failure.
    3829 * @details Call with the local instance lock held. Remove stale links
    3830 * before launch and clean up the child and links if startup fails. */
    3831static pid_t start_local_serial_bridge(void)
    3832{
    3833 unlink(USHER_LOCAL_SIM_DEVICE);
    3834 unlink(USHER_LOCAL_APP_DEVICE);
    3835
    3836 pid_t child = fork();
    3837 if (child < 0) {
    3838 perror("USHER: failed to fork socat");
    3839 return -1;
    3840 }
    3841 if (child == 0) {
    3842 char sim_endpoint[256];
    3843 char app_endpoint[256];
    3844 snprintf(sim_endpoint, sizeof(sim_endpoint), "pty,raw,echo=0,link=%s", USHER_LOCAL_SIM_DEVICE);
    3845 snprintf(app_endpoint, sizeof(app_endpoint), "pty,raw,echo=0,link=%s", USHER_LOCAL_APP_DEVICE);
    3846 execlp("socat", "socat", sim_endpoint, app_endpoint, (char *)NULL);
    3847 perror("USHER: failed to start socat");
    3848 _exit(127);
    3849 }
    3850
    3851 if (wait_for_path(USHER_LOCAL_SIM_DEVICE) != 0 || wait_for_path(USHER_LOCAL_APP_DEVICE) != 0) {
    3852 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tsocat did not create the local serial endpoints\n");
    3853 kill(child, SIGTERM);
    3854 waitpid(child, NULL, 0);
    3855 unlink(USHER_LOCAL_SIM_DEVICE);
    3856 unlink(USHER_LOCAL_APP_DEVICE);
    3857 return -1;
    3858 }
    3859 return child;
    3860}
    3861
    3862/** @brief Give the new serial bridge time to publish one endpoint.
    3863 * @param path Endpoint path to check.
    3864 * @return Zero if found during polling, or -1 if it never appears.
    3865 * @details Poll with a fixed attempt limit so failure to create a link
    3866 * is detected rather than waiting indefinitely for readiness. */
    3867static int wait_for_path(const char *path)
    3868{
    3869 for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++) {
    3870 if (access(path, F_OK) == 0) {
    3871 return 0;
    3872 }
    3873 sleep_microseconds(10000);
    3874 }
    3875 return -1;
    3876}
    3877
    3878/** @brief Stop the owned simulator bridge and release the local lock.
    3879 * @details Preserve child and endpoint ownership if termination cannot
    3880 * be confirmed. Links owned elsewhere are not removed. */
    3881static void stop_local_serial_bridge(void)
    3882{
    3883 if (local_bridge_owned && socat_pid > 0) {
    3884 kill(socat_pid, SIGTERM);
    3885 if (!wait_owned_child(&socat_pid, 100)) {
    3886 kill(socat_pid, SIGKILL);
    3887 if (!wait_owned_child(&socat_pid, 1500)) {
    3888 fprintf(stderr, "USHER:\tlocal serial bridge has not exited; retaining child ownership\n");
    3889 return;
    3890 }
    3891 }
    3892 }
    3893 if (local_bridge_owned) {
    3894 unlink(USHER_LOCAL_SIM_DEVICE);
    3895 unlink(USHER_LOCAL_APP_DEVICE);
    3896 local_bridge_owned = false;
    3897 }
    3898 if (local_lock_fd >= 0) {
    3899 close(local_lock_fd);
    3900 local_lock_fd = -1;
    3901 }
    3902}

    3906 * @details Notify the event loop rather than closing camera or UART state in
    3907 * the handler. Owners perform teardown in ordinary execution context. */
    3908static void handle_signal(int signal_number)
    3909{
    3910 (void)signal_number;
    3911 capture_set_running(&keep_running, false);
    3912 wake_event_loop();
    3913}
